640: Rammaa, ella mareh delishana bisha. bilchishu, bela aramut kala. lezimnin dachil chattaa ihu, lezimnin la. veda ihu beraza deat 7, kad kalil at 10.
Ad hacha, razin desaara lemare middin, deyade arche veraze deorayyta, leishtemoda temiru divne nasha, deinnun betzelem elohim satum shema, deitperash lechamma archin.

Beraza demitzcha, beat 50, deihu shelimu deat zayin, lezimnin itkelilat beraza deat 7, ulezimnin ihu bilchodaha. mitzcha deihu dakik vechad, bela iggula da hu bar nash dela mityayshva bedateh, chashiv deihu chakkim, velo yada. itbehil berucheh. chayyich (sefer acher nashecha) belishaneh kechivya.

Kemitin demitzcheh ravrevan, velav innun beziuuga. beshaata demallil itavidu innun kemitin bemitzcheh, velav beziuuga. reshimin acharanin di bemitzcheh kullehu beziuuga. da, bae dela leizdavvevga leh, ella zimna zeera, vela zimna saggi. kol ma deavad vechashav, ihu letoalte, vela chayish letoalta deacharanin. lav ihu mare derazin kelal. da ihu, (Mishlei 11:13) holech rachil megalle sod, vela chashiv milloy kelal. da ihu beraza deat 50 dichlila beat 7, vela ikre neeman ruach bekiyyuma.

Mitzcha dakik beiggula, da ihu bar nash chakkima, bema deistakkal. lezimnin itbehil berucheh. rechimu dileh bechedva. rachaman ihu al kolla, istakkal bemillin saggiin. i yishtaddal beorayyta leheve chakkim yattir.

Telat kemitin illain ravrevin bemitzcheh beshaata deihu mallil. telat kemitin kariv leena chad. utelat kemitin al ena achara. bache beshaata deargiz. da ihu tav yattir mikkamma deitchaze. armi batar kitfoy kol millin dealma, ben beovadoy, ben bemillin acharanin, vela chayish. atzlach beorayyta. kol bar nash

Vatztziv bivne nasha, da kayyeyma ben 90 uven 60. tamir mamoneh. la bae leagluye, uleitgele beovadoy. kamtztzan ihu. vesaareh gavil da im da, vetalyay. la chashiv garmeh lemilbash kedka yeot. ma delavish la ittakkan beh. mitztzecheh ravreva, telat sirtutin bimina, varba bismala teren reshimin ayylin benayyhu.

Da kad mallil pashit mashcha veinnun demitztzecha, sirtutin la itchazun kol kach. kafif resheh azil. yemina minneh semala. semala minneh yemina. atztziv tadir anina ihu, mareh delishana bisha. chashiv garmeh chakkim bechol ovadoy. mare devavu bechol innun demishtaddelan beorayyta.

Bidroa semala, it leh reshima uchama, 10 saarin zeirin bah, uteren ravrevin detalyayn beh sumakin. saara sheia vtale, vihu, lav sumak, velav ucham, mitztzecha dileh la rav vela zeer. da kayyeyma ben at 60, uven at 90 kelila beat 7.

Chad sirtuta rav bemitztzecheh, deazla befuteya, missitra da lesitra da. teren sirtutin acharanin, aval la reshimin kol kach, deha la kayyeymin missitra da lesitra da, kehay. arba kemitin zeirin kayyeymin, ben teren keritztzin, al resha dechotama leella.

Da ihu mareh dechedva, chakkim, pekiach, vavtran bemamoneh, bechol ma deishtaddal leminda ihu chakkim. lefum shaata ragaz, ulefum shaata nach rugezeh, la natar devavu lealmin. lezimna tav, ulezimna lav hachi kol kach, kaim bematkela. kad tav lemarih, mareh achid bideh, vsalik likar sagya. kolla tzerichin leh. at 60 azla ledideh tadir yattir meat 90. kol innun deyaatin aleh eta bisha, la matztzelichin, vela itkeyaym hahu eta, vela yachlin leavasha leh. itchaze rammaa velav hachi hu. at 60 vat 90 maggichin aleh, ubbegin kach salik venachit. kad tav lemareh, at 60 natztzach, veitavid reuteh becholla. rachaman ihu. uvache kad itmele rachamin.
Chad reshuma it leh bidroa yemina, vekayyeyma partztzufa, velet aleh saarin kelal. vi saara kemita, vela tale techot udenin, vihu kamit leella meudenin
641: Deyishtedal bahadeh yattir mimmillin acharanin dealma, lezimnin itdevak reiuteh bekudsha berich hu, ulezimnin la. bedina la atzlach. itrechak ihu min dina. veraza da at 50 bilchodoy, dela itkelilat beat 7. uvegin dela itkelilat beat 7, itrechak min dina, vela kaim beh, urechimuta ihu sitra dileh.

Mitzcha deihu bela iggula, veihu ravreva. hay ihu bar nash dechol zimnin kad kaim, vechad azil, kafif resheh. hay itpelig litren lesitrin, veinnun sitre shigona. sitra chada ihu shigona deitchaze, uvene nasha acharanin yadin shigona, deishtemoda kame kolla. veihu tippesha.

Bemitzcheh it 4 kemitin ravrevin, lezimnin beshaata demallil kamit lon bemitzcheh, ulezimnin deitpeshat mitzcheh bemashcheh, vela itchazun. innun kemitin itchazun, kemitin acharanin ravrevin besitra deenoy, chayich lemaggana. pumeh ravreva. lav ihu var nash letoalta. sitra achara ihu. shigona deitkasse beh, uvene nasha la mistakkelan beh. veihu itchakkam bema deishtaddal, vaafillu beorayyta, aval la lishmah, ella begin leitgaa bifne amma. vecholla bilchishu uvegaavat libba, leachazaa deihu zakkaa velav hachi. kol milloy lav innun lishma dekudesha berich hu, ella begin bene nasha. vechashiv machashavin, veanhig garmeh. keminhaga dilvar, deyistakkelun beh. hay ihu beraza deat 50, di bichlala deat 7.

Mitzcha deihu beiggula ravreva, pekicha ihu, dabberanu (sefer acher dakeranev) decholla beh. yada bechol ma deishtaddal, afillu bela umana deyolif leh. atzlach bechol ma deishtaddal. uvemamona, lezimnin atzlach, lezimnin la. mimmilla zeera istachal bemillin saggiin. navon ikre. la chayish lemillin dealma, vaafillu deyinda deyitkesif

Mitztzecheh rav velav kol kach. sirtutin dileh chamesh. telat avrin missitra da lesitra da, uteren la avrin. mare ketata ihu, uveveteh yattir. kol ovadoy bivhilu, itchaze tav, velav hachi. shavach garmeh bema dela it beh. da kaim beat 7 lechud, vsalik lemerachik beat tz lechod, mate vla mate at 60 let beh kelal. vavtran bemilluleh vla yattir, ail garmeh bema dela itchaze leh, man deishtattaf bahadeh, itztzetrich leistammera mechamidu dileh, aval atztzelach ihu bahadeh.

Saara detale vela sheia, vesaareh rav. chamesh sirtutin beh, dematu vela matu da leda, ayynin dileh tzehivin pikchin. da kafif resheh. itchazi tav vezakkaa, vlav hachi. shavach garmeh. i ishtaddal beorayyta kevar nash rav. takkif beyitztzereh. kad mallil, akmit chotameh ufashit mashcha demitztzecheh. kol ovadoy lechezu divne nasha, atztzelach bemamona, rammaa ihu bechol ovadoy. mare delishana bisha. yada leistammera mibbene nasha becholla. shigona beh, veitkasse bema deihu avid. ail ketatin bilchishu.

Udenoy ravrevan, kayymin bekiyyumayyhu techot saara, da kayyeyma beat 90 veat 7, uvegin kach ovadoy lechezu bene nasha. ben kitfoy talyayn telat saarin bela reshima kelal. man deishtattaf bahadeh la atztzelach. vihu atztzelach berammauta dileh, veitchazzi zakkaa leachara, vechashiv deavad lokovleh ovade keshot.

Saara kemita vtale techot udenin, i ihu ravavk, chad sirtuta bemitztzecheh, utelat kemitin al resha dechotmin, ben keritztzin dileh. mareh dechedva ihu. pekicha vecholla. rammaa. vvtran ihu, avid vavtranuta leinun dimkarvin bahadeh. da kayyeyma beat 60 veat 7. vechad havi siv, mitchallefan (sefer acher tziyyura deatvavn) atvvn, at 7 beresha, veat 60 bahadeh. lav ihu vvtran, ella beveteh. atztzelach bemamoneh. rammaa la havi. ade garmeh mehahu archa.
Al keritztza semala, it chad rishuma zeer, demacha leh bar nash beyome olymoy, atim ena yemina. chamesh kemitin al resha dechutameh, befuteyih ben keritztze enoy. saara kemita zeer al
642: Behu la chayish lon, vela shavi al libbeh. rachich libba ihu.

Teren kemitin illain ravrevin bemitzcheh. chad kemita al ena chad, vechad kemita al ena achara. veishtechachu telat kemitin ravrevin bemitzcheh, beillen deayynin, bar kemita tattaa, deihu itpelag al ayynin. da chashiv machashavin lego vela levar. begin dela chashiv livne nasha beovadoy, vedachil ihu lefum shaata, vela yattir. lefayyusa, itpayyeysa beovadoy dilvar mikkame bar nash, lav innun, ella lezimnin keravya, ulezimnin bechachma. da ihu beraza deat 50, deihu bilchodoy, dela itkelil beat 7. vechalsha ihu, dela itkelil beillen atvavn kadmae, ella istemich leat 60 leitkelala beh. vela beatvavn kadmae. ad hacha razin dechachmeta demitzcha.
Beraza deayynin, beraza deat 60, behahu gavvna desachara levar, uchema deyatva ena, deyatva al shelimu, dela shekia, hay lav rammaa hi, verachik merammauta, dela it beh kelal.

Gavvne deayynin innun 4. chivvavru levar, desachara ena, kegavvna dechol bar nash. lego minneh uchama desachara, veitkelil chivvavru veuchamu kachada. lego minneh yeroka. veitkelil beuchama. lego minneh hahu bat ena, nekuda uchama. da ihu bar nash dechayich tadir, vechadde bechedu. vechashiv machashavin letav, vela ishtelimu innun machashavin, begin desalik lon miyyad meruteh. ishtaddal bemille dealma. vechad ishtaddal bemille dishmayya, atzlach. hay itzterich leittatkefa beh leishtaddela beorayyta, deha yitzlach bah.
Gevini enoy ravrevin, vechasyayn letatta. beinnun gavvnin deena it reshimin sumakin dekikin bearka. innun reshimin ikrun atvavn zeirin deena. begin deinnun gavvnin deena. i

Resheh. kamit deayynin. da ihu beat 7 bilchodoy. bela sachletanu. shigona belibbeh. bahil beovadoy. chad sirtuta al mitztzecheh. vearba acharanin zeirin. let beh mehemanuta, la yishtattaf bar nash bahadeh, dela yitztzelach. chayyayva ihu lemareh bechol ovadoy.

Chad tuleduta zeera it leh al yarcha semala. lezimnin itmeche, ulezimnin ityylid. vei arba sirtutin al mitztzecheh, kol hani it beh, aval let ba tuledata. vei telat ravrevin utelat zeirin, shappiru desaara ihu, veihu beemtztzaita. ad kan raza desaara.

Mitztzecha mitparsha besara, umitztzecha mitparsha beayynin, ena mitparsha besara, led sitrin. bevat ena, bigvavnin deena, bechiuvru deena, beukkamu deena. kol istakkeluta leistakkela, bechol innun simanin deshit dekaamran, let lehu ella 53 shenin uleella, deitparsha ruach kudsha meruach mesaava. bar besirtute bilchodoy, desirtutin ben zeera uven rav mitchallefe tadir vchen bechullehu.

Ketiv (Shemot 18:25) vayyivchar moshe anshe chayil mikkol yisrael vegomer, deillu al innun simanin acharanin baa vela ashkach. vechen (Devarim 1:15) havu lachem anashim chachamim viduim leshivtechem. may yeduim. deishtemodan beinnun simanin, vashkach, bar nevonim dela ashkach.

Ena beraza deat Rabbi veat 80, degvinin chivvavrin vesaara sumaka. i gevinin deenoy chivvavrin, da hu bar nash deitztzetrichu bene nasha leistammera minneh. kol milloy berammauta. pekicha ihu. natir devavu. da ihu beat Rabbi bilchodoy. vla itchabbar bahadeh at 80. at da, azla vshat aleh, vela ityashsheva beh. enoy deda shekiin, bahil beovadoy. vechen kol man deenoy shekiin, itztzetrich leistammera minneh bechol ovadin. rammaa ihu, uverammauteh yahiv taama lemilloy.

Mitztzecha dileh rav, vla iggula. teren reshimin ravrevin azlin befuteya demitztzecheh, missetar listar, vearba zeirin. saara dileh talya. karir mocha ihu. veal da pekicha havi. udenoy zeirin, bidrooy saara rav. nakid ihu binkudin
643: Nehirin binhiru, hahu nehiru salik atvavn leitchazaa, leinun mari demiddin. beinnun reshimin acharanin dekikin, vehay ihu beat 60, uchelila beat Adonai.
Ayynin yerokin desacharin (nusach acher damesacheraa) bechivvavru, umitarvin innun yerokin, behahu chivvavru. rachamana ihu, veihu chashiv tadir letoalte, vela chashiv lenizka deacharanin kelum.

Gavvna uchama la itchaze beh. chamid ihu vela missitra bisha. vei salleka bideh missitra bisha, la yetuv minneh. mehemana ihu bema deishtemodo. uvamme dela ishtemoda lav mehemana ihu. mareh derazin ihu, bemilla deihu raza, ad deyishma lehahu raza beatar achara. kevan dishma leh galle kolla. velav immeh raza kelal, dechol milloy lav innun bishlimu. gavvne enoy sacharan bechivvavru uviroka. da ihu beraza deat Adonai, veitkelil beat 7, uveat 60.

Ayynin tzehivin yerokin, shigona it beh. uvegin shigoneh ihu pum memallel ravrevan, veavid garmeh kevar nash rav, beravrevanu. uman deittakkaf beh, netzach leh. la itchaze lerazin deorayyta, deha la shachich belibbeh, beinnun razin. deavid garmeh rav behu. da ihu beraza deat Adonai, veitkelil beat 7 bilchodoy, veitrechak meat 60. uvegin deihu aved garmeh beravrevanu, itrechak minneh meat 60, vela itkeriv bahadeh. da kad ihu mallil, avid kemitin saggiin bemitzcheh.

Ayynin chivvavrin, desacharan zeer biroka, mareh derugeza, verachamana ihu lerov zimnin. vechad itmele rugeza, let beh rechimu kelal, veithappach leachzariyyut. lav ihu mareh derazin, da ihu beraza deat Adonai, deitkelil beat 60.
Ayynin yerokin vechivvavrin kachada, uzeer miggavevn ucham behu, da ihi mareh derazin, veatzlach behu. vei shaari
Dirshimin ukkamin. vei reshimin sumakin, tav lezimnin lemebad tivu, veitkayyaym beh zimna zeera, ulezimnin tav lekilkuleh. chamdan ihu.

Zara dedavid behippucha. david malka yarit da sumaka shappira, lemebad dina, ulemebad shappiru deovadoy. enoy aynin derachame, yatvin al shelimu, sallekin chinna vechisda. chad chuta yeroka azil begavvavyyhu. beshaata deaggach kerava, hahu chuta ithappach vithavi sumaka kevvrda. nach rugezeh bikrava, tav hahu chuta kemilkaddemin. nissin (kesin) ravrevin havo beenoy. havo chaddan. teivin lemecheme. nekudin bitlat gavvnin, chidu delibba havo belev kolla, chayyayvayya demistakkelin behu, havo zain vedachalin, sallekin belibbayyhu emata udechilu.

Mitztzecha dileh rav iggula bishfiru, vchol atvavn itchazun vesallekin beh, illen sallekin villen nachtin. innun denachtin sallekin, yahavin ducheta illen leillen. begin kach reshimin dileh sallekin bearka leella. gevinin deenoy rachamin lerachamanuta. la ukkamin vela sumakin, ella ben teren gavvnin. bat ena dilgo, achze kol diukenin dealma, chuta sumaka sachara leh, vechedvav sechor sechor kolla.

Sheruta, dechayyayvin mekarvin lemecheme, innun chayyayvayya chaman lon chayychan, rachame chinna vechisda. levatar tukepa udechilu veemtanu vrugeza. veenoy yvnim legabbayyhu. may yonim. deavdin lon onaa lechayyayvayya. kema deat amer (Vayikra 25:17) lo tonu ish et amito uchetiv (Shir HaShirim 1:15) enayich yonim. mekarvan, umerachakan. kol diyyukenin dealma kullehu kelilan beanpoy. saara deresheh, hava rashim bigvavni shiva zine dahava.

Chamena besifra deadam kadmaa, deamar hachi diyyukenin dimshicha kadmaa, lesihara, gon dileh, zahav yerakrak beanpoy. gon dileh, zehav ofir bedikneh. gon dileh, zehav sheva bigvinoy. gon dileh (divrei hayamim 2 3:6) zehav parvayim, bikritztzin deal enoy. gon dileh, zahav sagur besara deresheh. gon dileh, zahav mufaz al chaddoy belucha deal libbeh. gon dileh zehav tarshish, al teren deroin. kol shiva gavvnin illen, havo
644: Beatzlachuta atzlach vesalik. sanoy la yachlin leh, veihu shallit alayyhu beshuletanu, veitkafyayn kameh. da ihu beraza deat 20, deitkelil beraza deat 60. veal da ihu shallit, i shaari beh. ad hacha razin deayynin leinun mare dechachmeta.

Raza deanpin, leinun mare dechachmeta penimaa. diukenin deanpin, lav innun birshimin dilvar, ella bego reshima derazin penimain. dediyyukenin deanpin, mithappechan miggo diukenin dirshimu deanpin, setimin berucha desharya lego. umiggo hahu rucha, itchaze levar diukenin deanpin, deishtemodan legabbe innun chakkimin.

Diukenin deanpin ishtemodan miggo rucha. rucha it bevar nash, derazin deatvavn chakikin beh. vechullehu atvavn setimin go hahu rucha, ulefum shaata sallekin reshimin deinnun atvavn lego anpin. uchema deinnun atvavn sallekin, hachi itchazun anpin, bediyyukenin reshimin lefum shaata, bechezu dela kayyeyma. bar innun mare dechachmeta deitkayyeyman behu, vela itnneshe minnayyhu.

Hahu atar deikre alma deate, (ihu raza deorayyta) umittamman nafka raza deorayyta, bechullehu atvavn deinnun 22 atvavn, kelala decholla. vehahu nahara denafik meeden, natil kolla. vechad parchan minneh innun ruchin venishmatin, kullehu mitztayyeyran betziyyura deinnun atvavn, vehachi nafke kullehu. ubbegin kach, rucha devar nash demitztayyeyra betziyyura deatvavn, avid tziyyura beanpin.

Amar leh rabbi shimon, i hachi tziyyura deima, la mitztayyeyra go hahu rucha, amru, hachi shemana minneh demor, detziyyura deatvavn missitra dilella, vetziyyura deema mitztayyeyra behahu rucha letatta. tziyyura deatvavn itgenizu lego, vetziyyura deema balit levar.
Tziyyura deima, pene adam, pene arye, pene sor, pene nesher. verucha avid tziyyura dechullehu levar lefum shaata, begin dechol ma deihu missitra
Reshimin, al kol innun duchete desaaroy.

Bidroa yemina, hava chakik verashim reshuma chada satim mibbene nasha, migdal chakik bearyi. vealef zeera rashim begavvih, vesimana da (Shir HaShirim 4:4) elef hammagen taluy alav. kol zimna deaggach kerava, hahu reshima salleka uvalta, veal migdal mechashkesha hay alef, ucheden ittakkaf leaggacha kerava. kad al bikrava mechashkesha hahu arye, ucheden itgabbar kearyi, venetztzach keravin. vhahu migdal itrehit, vsimaneh (Mishlei 18:10) bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav. venisgav davd missanoy dela yachlin legabbeh. umin simanin illen ureshimin illen, havo reshimin bedareh semala. reshuma devar nash achara lav kehay.
Ayynin tzehivin pekiin, shigona belibbeh. mitztzecha rav. saaroy saggiin, talyayn, rechikin mimmashcha deresha. pekicha ihu. pum memallel ravrevan. sifvavn dileh attikin mareh delishana bisha.
Bemitztzecheh telat sirtutin, i beeneh teren shureyayke sumake, da hava beat Rabbi bilchodoy, veshureyyka zahir legabbayyhu. avera izdammenat legabbeh, vishteziv minah.

Vei shureyyka chada sumaka lego beena, kayyeyma bearka, uteren zeirin techoteh, vechad deabar beenoy. deden it leh eta bisha, beitteta asura, vaadayin eta kayyeyma. keden tishtechach bemitztzecheh, chad sirtuta learka. mikkeritztza yemina chad saara vearba zeirin techoteh, vechad deabar benayyhu lefuteyih.

Vei yitperash mehahu chataa, tishkach beeneh, teren shureyayke dekikin, azlin befuteyih deena, vela abar chad benayyhu, vechen bemitztzecha. umizman deitperash mehahu chova, hu mizzeman 9 yom, deha mittamman ulehala, yitmachun reshimin illen, veyityeylidu acharanin.

Ayynin dekikin, umithappechan zeir besumaka. da ihu pekicha. kol milloy (sefer acher betiyyuveta) vechiuva. bemitztzechoy tishkach reshimin telat. chad rav, deabar missitra da lesitra da. uteren acharanin dela avrin. keritztzin deenoy ravrevin. mareh dekashyu ihu. kad mallil, kamit bechutemin, berugezih, (sefer acher o) i bekashyu delibbeh. zakif shum bish aleh. bish beene decholla. kolla sanin leh. atztzelach lezimnin ulezimnin la.
645: Derucha balta levar, veitchazze veitgeniz. vechol hane diukenin, itchazyayn, mittzayyeyran betziyyura deatvavn af al gav deinnun genizin. illen arba diukenin itchazyayn lefum shaata, leinun mare deayynin, deyadin beraza dechachmeta leistakkela behu.

Tziura kadmaa, kad azil bar nash beorach keshot, innun deyadin berazin demarehon mistakkelan beh, begin dehahu rucha dilgo, metatkena beh, uvalit levar, tziyyura decholla. vehahu tziyyura ihu tziyyura deadam, veda ihu tziyyura shelim yattir mikkol tziyyurin. veda ihu tziyyura, deabar lefum shaata, kame enayyhu dechakkime libba. hay kad mistakkelan beanpoy levar, innun anpin dekayymin kameh, ayynin delibba rachim lon.

Arba simanin deatvavn it behu, shureyyka chad balit bishchivu, besitra diyimina, veshureyyka chad dechalil teren acharanin daachidan beh, besitra dismala. veillen 4 simanim, innun 4 atvavn, deikrun edut vesimana da 70. hahu shureyyka distar yemina, devalit bishchivu. 4 veinnun terin atvavn demitchabberan beh (sefer acher 406 inun 480) 406 innun hahi shureyyka dechalil teren acharanin, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef shemo dechol man dechama leh hava rachim leh belibboy, uvirchimu ishtelim.

Zara dedavid mithappechan beh chezu digvavnin, ubbegin kach taa shemuel, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 16:7) al tabbet el marehu, begin desitra achara hava beh beeliav, dela hava hachi bedavid, deyyukenin dedavid temirin innun, deha deyyukenin desitra achara, itkelil go diyyukenin, vehahu diyyukena distar achara itchaze beh bekadmita, deabar al ayynin lefum shaata, uvahil libba vedachil, ulevatar (Shmuel 1 16:12) vetov roi vaAdonai immo. veda ihu edut legabbeh.
Diyyukena da deadam, kalil kol diukenin, vechullehu kelilan beh, hay la bahil berucheh. beshaata derugezeh ihu benayycha, umilloy benayycha, umiyyad itpayyays.
Bechaddoy al libbeh. sifvavn dileh attikin, mareh gauta beshigona. lishana bisha.

Saaroy sheiin ravrevin vesaggiin. anpoy anpin arichin zeer, veaggulin zeer, lezimnin itcharat mikkol ma deavad vetav lekilkuleh. beeneh tishkach shureyayke, teren beena dimina, vechad beena dismala. udenoy zeirin, kayymin bekiyyuma.

Zara dedavid behippucha. zara dedavid kol simanin illen letav, ulemebad tivu. bar sifvvn ravrevin, dechol man deshifvavteh ravrevin, mareh delishana bisha ihu, ben zakkaa, ben chayyayva. bar i tzaddik gamur hu. uvezachyu dileh natztzach venatir garmeh.

Ayynin yerokin, zeir miggavivn sumak azil benayyhu, bemitztzecheh teren reshumin, missitra da lesitra da, vechad leella zeera, vechad letatta. ihu beat 80 veat Rabbi. da mitztzecheh rav beiggula, ihu tav lecholla. yahiv mikkol ma deit leh lechol bar nash. vtran ihu. saaroy sheia vetale. bistar yemina it leh chivvavru desaare, miyyoma deitbere.

Matnitin. bene alma marehon desachletanu, pekichin marehon ayynin, dimhemanuta, di hava geniza bechu. man minnechun desalik venachit. man di ruach elahin kaddishin beh. likum velinda, beshaata desalik biruta deresha chivvavra, lemivre adam, batash bego butztzina chada, uvatash butztzina bifshitu denahir, vhahu peshitu devutztzina appik nishmatin.

Uf hachi batash go tinara chada takkifa, vappik hahu tinara shalhvva chada melahata, merukkama bechamma gavvnin, vehahu shalhova salleka venachta, ad dehahu peshitu (nusach acher pateyshev) batash beh, vetav vityeshav beducheteh, vitavid rucha dechayyi.

Vehahu rucha ittecham, venatil gon chad mishshimsha. nachit letatta, natil gon chad missihara. sata limina, natal gon mayyay, kalil befuma dearye chada. sata lismala, natal gon essa, kalil befuma dechad shor, sumaka kevavrda. sata lekameh, natal gon rucha, kalil befuma dechad nesher ravreva, rav gadpin, mareh denotztza, kol gavvnin beh mitchamman. sata laachora, natal gon afra, kalil 44 sitre alma. befuma deadam, vechol diyyukenin mistakkelan legabbeh.
646: Zara dedavid deitchaze beh hahu diyyukena bekadmita, deabar lefum shaata al ayynin, berugezeh benayycha, miyyad itpayyays. aval natir devavu kenachash lesofa. begin dehahu sitra garma leh, desachara bechol sitrin. aval mocha divgo kelifa velibba mityashshera, veyatztziva da leinun zakkain. aval chayyayvin la mitabberan mehahu diyyukena kadmaa bisha, veitchabberan (vaasateaben) beh becholla.

Tziura tinyayna, i hahu bar nash la azil kol kach bearcha bisha, veaste mehahu archa, vetav lemarih, la dehu regila bearchoy dimtakkenan, ella ihu dehava beinnun orche mitade, vesate minnayyhu vetav lemareh. hay ihu rucha tava share lemishri aloy, uleittatkefa al zuhama kadmaa dehava beh, uvalit levar, beistakkeluta, deayynin lefum shaata, kechad diyyukena dearye deitgabbar hay beshaata dechame leh, hahu chezu garim leh leabar belibbeh arye demitgabbera lefum shaata.

Hay mistakkelan beanpoy levatar, innun anpin delibba la rachim lon lefum shaata, umiyyad tav libbeh verachim leh. kad mistakkelan beh achsif, vechashiv decholla yadin be. anpoy chafyayn dama lefum shaata, mithappechan lechivvevra o liroka.

Telat shureyykan it beanpoy. chad limina, deda itpashat beanpoy veitachid beh. chad desalleka lechotameh leella, uteren lismala. vechad deitpashshat letatta meinnun terin, veachid behay uvehay. veillen innun atvavn demitchakkekan beanpoy, veinnun baltin dela shechivin. vechad mityayshva veargil beorach keshot, shechivin.
Veraza deinnun atvavn ihu kariv. da hava rachik, vehasheta innun atvavn baltin beanpoy, vesahadin beh bivhilu. vesimana da 100 (davar acher Adonai) missetar yemina atvavn acharanin missetar

Ityayshshav hahu rucha behahu afra, veitlavash beh. keden hahu afra, mechashkesha venachat letatta, vechanash afra 44 sitrin dealma, veitavid diyyukena chada ufartztzufa, vehahu rucha ittammar miggo lego. vehahu afra deitkenish 44 sitrin batash legabbeh nefesh kelila beafra (sefer acher berucha.)

Vehahu nefesh ihu yesoda leovade gufa. kefum ovadin dehahu nefesh begufa, hachi itchazi bemashcha levar. rucha da ittammar lego. vehahu achze levar, salik venachit, uvatash beanpoy, veachze diyyukenin ureshimin. batash bemitztzecheh, achze diyyukenin ureshimin batash beenoy, veachze diyyukenin ureshimin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:9) hakkarat penehem anta bam.

Butztzina deitmeshach minneh medidu, dechad chuta yeroka, shalhavuta detohu. batash bidoy beshaata devar nash naim, verashim reshimin vesirtutin bideh, uchefum ovadin debar nash hachi itreshim. veillen atvavn mithappechan mittatta leella, veyade lon chavre keshot, birshimu deatvavn devutztzina, vechol illen chelin dilgo bebar nash, avdin reshumin vshirtutin atvavn mithappechan. man derakim da, rakim beshippule mashkena. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:15) rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz. berich hu berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin.
Ayynin chivvavra, veevarin sumakin, beatreh denafik minneh, da ihu beat 80 vat Rabbi kelila kachada.

Mitztzecheh rav, telat sirtutin sallekin bemitztzecheh, shit zeirin acharanin. sumak hu vla sumak, kayyeyma ben teren gavvnin. saareh uf hachi. anpoy ravrevan. saareh kamit, vela kol kach. tale zeer techot udenoy. tav ihu, mare dimhemnuta, mare derugeza takkif, beshaata deitregiz.

Hahu sumaka ditchot ena, itpashat beeneh. rugezeh bish. beshaata demallil berugezeh satim pumeh, venafik tenana minnechiroy. velizman zeer nach rugezeh, vela kol rugezeh, ad yoma achara, o teren yomin. da atztzelach lezimnin, ulezimnin la. aval kaim tadir beatztzelachuta, ben zeer uven rav.
Vei sumaka defum ena, zeer kechuta, vela itpashat beshaata derugezih beena, vit beh kol hane simanin. chalsha belibba. veihu dachil mikkolla,
647: Semala, veaf al gav deshureyayke acharanin itchazun beanpoy, la baltin levar kehane. bar bezimna dehava azil beakkimu.

Hayi ihu zara dedavid, ithappach mechezu da. bekadmita itchaze bediyyukena deadam, ulevatar kayyma bediyyukena dearye, veitperash bediyyukena desitra achara, uvecholla, mithappecha mishshear bene nasha.

Tziura telitaa, i hahu bar nash azil bearcha dela metatkena, vesate orchoy mearche deorayyta, hahu rucha kaddisha istallak minneh, verucha achara itchaze beh, udeyukena achara, uvalit levar, beistakkeluta deayynin dechakkime libba, lefum shaata diyyukena deshor. beshaata dechaman leh, maberan belibbayyhu hahu diyyukena, veistakkelan beh.

3 Kuretame sumake beanpoy, besitra dimina, veinnun shureyayke sumakin dekikin. utelat bismala, veillen innun atvavn devaltin beh. chad ihu shureyyka dakik beiggula, uteren dekikin acharanin aleh, vechullehu beiggula. ucheden shekiin enoy.

Veraza deinnun atvavn. chad ihu 20, teren acharanin 600 innun. vechen listar semala, vesimana da hahu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:9) hakkarat penehem anta bam veillen atvavn baltin beanpin, al kol shear shureyaykin. vei tav missemala limina, itkafya hahu rucha veittakkaf rucha dekudsha, veillen shureyaykin shechivu, veacharanin baltin levar, kema deittemar.

Zara dedavid ihu behippucha, itchazya bediyyukena dearye bekadmita, ulevatar ithaddar bediyyukena deshor. terin shureyaykin ukkamin beanpoy, chad mimina, vechad missemala, veillen innun atvavn, chad ikre 4, vechad ikre 70, vecholla mithappecha mishshear bene nasha.

Tziura reviaa, da ihu tziyyura devar nash, dekayyeyma tadir leittakna al raza demilkaddemin, hay ihu chezu lechakkime libba bediyyukena denesher. hahu rucha dileh ihu rucha chalsha. hay la achze beanpin atvavn devaltin levar, deha itavidu minneh, veishtekau bezimna achara demilkaddemin, deistallaku minneh, veal da la baltin beyih.

Veraza dileh, enoy la nehirin bintzitzu, kad ihu bechedva. uvezimna desafar sear resheh vediknih. begin derucheh la nahir leh beatvavn, veishteka netzitzu dileh dehava bekadmita. la kayyeyma beistakkeluta deanpin leistakkela. veraza dehay (Kohelet 4:2) veshabbeach ani et hammetim shekkevar metu min hachayyim asher hemma chayyim adenna. zara dedavid, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam.

Berucha devar nash, itzteyyayru atvavn, kema deittemar, veiyihu balit lon levar, veitmesar chachmeta da lechakkime libba leminda uleishtemoda, rucha kayyma beraza (Bereshit 5) deze sefer, vecholla beraza da kayyeyma, bar chezu deanpin deittedan begavvna achara, kefum shuletanu
Shenateh la ityayshshav beh. chashiv tadir machashavin vedachil mikkullehu. veatztzelach lecholla. mareh digria (dageyydaa). la chash legiyyufa.

Lezimnin tav bityuveta vedachil. umiggo dechilu, keden tishkach beeneh yemina, hahu sumaka defum ena, besofa beshippule ena, vchad shureyayka dakik sumak beeneh semala, vi mitchallefe ma dimina lismala, uma dismala limina, keden ihu bekilkuleh. vtav vetavar geziza devarda, begin leabera avera.

Teren kemitin al resha utelat deena, letatta. uveragleh semala, beetztzeba deemtztzaita, shit saarin, uvezimna achara chamesh, vhasheta shit, chad zeira benayyhu. ayynin ukkamin, ukeritztzin deal enoy ravrevin, saggiin saarin, illen al illen, vinnun ayynin ukkamin veyaroka, azil begavvavyyhu, vehahu yeroka atba yattir. hay it leh chamesh sirtutin bemitztzecha, teren deavrin missetar listar. utelat dela avrin vechulei.

(Shemot 19:1) bachodesh hashelishi letzet bene yisrael vegomer, deshalit beh 248 leh, rav memana, utelat mea veshittin vechamesh ribbo mashreyayn immeh, kechusheban yome shatta. vechullehu it lon telat mea veshittin vechamesh maftechan nehorin, mehahu nehora denafka miggo chashmal illaa penimaa ganiz vesatim, di razin deatvavn kaddishin illain dishma kaddisha,
648: Derucha, o marih derucha. zakkain innun chakkimin decholla itmesar lon leminda. ad hacha raza deanpin.

Mikkan ulehala beraza desifvavn, beat 80 dechalil beraza deat 60. sifvavn ravrevan, da ihu bar nash mallil belishana bisha, vela achsif, vela dachil, mare demachloket, rechila ihu ben hay lehay. (Mishlei 6:19) umeshalleach medanim ben achim. lav ihu marih derazin, vechad ishtaddal beorayyta mechasse razin, aval marih delishana bisha, vela shavi dechilu belibbeh.
Vesimana da, at 80 dechalil beat Rabbi vela itkelil beat 60. hay ihu deitchaze deihu zakkaa, vela dachil chattaa ihu, vela bae leishtaddela avatreh, begin dechol milloy innun befuma vela begufa.

Sifvavn attikin beattiku, velav dekikin. hay ihu bar nash mareh derugeza yattir. marih dizdona. la yachil lemisbal milla. mare delishana bisha befarhesya, bela kissufa kelal. lezimnin ishtaddal beletzanuta. hay ihu bar nash devae leitrachako minneh.

Itmele dikneh besara, hahu, lishana bisha, ori aleh befarhesya, let leh kissufa. ishtaddal bemachloket. atzlach bemille dealma. chame besanoy. da ihu (Mishlei 6:13) koretz beenav, al da ittemar (Mishlei 21:29) heez ish rasha befanav. da ihu beraza deat 80 bilchodoy. dela itkelil beat 60 kelal. ulezimnin itchabbar beat Rabbi behay at Rabbi itkelil.

Beraza deudenin, man deudenoy ravrevin, tippesha belibbeh veshigona berucheh. man deudenoy zeirin, vekayymin al kiyyuma. pekicha delibba beitaruta ihu. tzave leishtaddela becholla. veraza da at 10 deitkelil bechol shear atvavn.

Ad hacha, razin dediyyukenin devar nash. mikkan ulehala, razin acharanin beatvavn demor, dela kayymin go partzufa, ella leminda razin dehay pesuka, go dargin illain, bizmanin utekifin dehay alma, vela zachenan behu.

Amar Rabbi shimon, banay, zakkain attun bealma, den, uvealma deate, vezakkain enay, deyizkun lemecheme da, kad eul lehahu alma deate. begin nishmati kare leattik yomin, hay kera, (Tehillim 23:5) taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray dishshanta vashshemen roshi kosi revaya. vekudesha berich hu kare alan, (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim. "

Uf innun patchu veamru, ketiv (Yechezkel 1:8) vide adam mittachat kanfehem, hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, deinnun yedin lekabbela marihon ditiuveta detavaan legabbe (nusach acher lekabbel) kudesha berich hu. aval yede adam, illen innun deyyukenin verazin illain, deshavvi kudesha berich hu bevar nash, vesidder lon beetzbean levar ulego. uvehahu kaf.

Vekudesha berich hu kad bara leh levar nash, sider beh, kol diyyukenin derazin illain, dealma dilella, vechol diyyukenin derazin tattain, dealma diltatta, vecholla mitchakkeka bebar nash, deihu kaim betzelem elohim, begin deikre yetzir kaf.

Veraza dechaf, deat da deikre kaf, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo, da ihu raza deat kaf. at da, it beh razin illain, vediyyukenin illain. behay kaf talyayn eser amiran mimina umissemala, chamesh mimina, vechamesh missemala, veinnun chad beraza chada.

(Tanenan ketiv 0 vegam ani akke kefi el kefi, dalehavev da im da bapelavegatea vaysatelakev birchan mealma, hoil vegeuta deyisrael ityehivat leammin. kad mitchabberan kachada, ketiv, 1 kaf achat esre zahav melea ketoret ramaz lechibbura chada.) vechad havo bechibbura chada, ketiv, vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo vegomer. vayyivra elohim (et haadam) da seliku demachashava beraza penimaa. et haadam: raza dechar venukeba kachada, betzelem elohim raza dechaf (achara).
Kad itbere adam, ma ketiv, beh, (Iyov 10:11) or (Bereshit 20 amud bet) uvasar talbisheni
649: Vegomer. i hachi haadam mahu. i tema, deeno ella or uvasar veatzamot vegidim, lav hachi, deha vadday haadam lav ihu ella nishmeta. veillen dekaamar or uvasar atzamot vegidim, kullehu la havo ella malbusha bilchodoy, manin innun devar nash, velav innun adam. vechad hay adam istallak, itpashat meinnun manin deka levish.

Or deitlebash beh bar nash. vechol innun atzmot vegidim, kullehu beraza dechachmeta illaa kegavvna dilella. or kegavvna dilella, kema deolif mor, beinnun yeriot, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:2) note shamayim kayria. (Shemot 25:5) orot elim meaddamim veorot techashim. innun malbushin dilella, dimsakkeche lemalbusha, itpashshatuta deshamayim, deihu malbusha dilvar. yeriot innun malbusha dilgo, veihu keruma desachich al bisra.
Atzmot vegidim, innun retichin, vechol innun chayyaylin, dekayymin lego. vechullehu malbushin lifnimaa, raza deadam illaa, deihu penimaa.

Uf hachi raza letatta, adam ihu penimaa lego. malbushin dileh kegavvna dilella. atzmot vegidin, kegavvna dekamran beinnun retichin umashiryayn. basar ihu sachich al innun mashiryayn uretichin, vekayyeyma levar, veda (Vayikra 170 amud alef) raza deitmashshecha lesitra achara. or desachich al kolla, da ihu kegavvna deinnun rekiin, desachichu al kolla. vechullehu malbushin leitlabbesha behu. penimaa dilgo raza deadam. vecholla raza, letatta kegavvna dilella. veal da vayyivra elokim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elokim, (tere elohim hacha chad kelappe dechar vechad kelappe nukeba) veraza deadam letatta kolla ihu beraza dilella.

Behay rekia dilella, dimsakkech al kolla, itreshimu beh reshimin, leitchazaa uleminda beinnun reshimin, deitkeviu beh millin verazin setimin. veinnun reshimin dekochavayya umazzale, deitreshimu veitkeviu behay rekia, desachich levar. uf hachi or, deihu sikkucha levar bevar nash, deihu rekia desachich al kolla, it beh reshimin vesirtutin, veinnun kochavayya umazzale dehay or. leitchazaa behu, uleminda behu, millin verazin setimin, bechochavayya umazlay, leayyeyna behu chakkime libba, uleistakkela behu leminda istakkeluta beanpin, berazin dekaamaran, veraza da, (Yeshayahu 47:13) hovre shamayim hachozim bakkochavim.

Veda ihu, kad innun nehirin vekayymin, belo rugeza. bezimna derugeza shalta aleh devar nash, dina achara itmesar leminda beh. bema dela ityeyhiv leshalletaa, leminda bezimna deena (nusach acher dedina) shalta birkia.

Aval istakkeluta deanpin al arach keshot, beshaata deanpin nehirin, vekayyeyma bar nash al kiyyuma, veinnun reshimin itchazun beorach keshot, dichden behahu istakkeluta yachil leittedana al bureyeh yattir, veaf al gav divcholla kol innun chakkimin yachlin leistakkela.
Sirtute yedin vesirtute etzbean, lego, kullehu kayymin berazin acharanin, leminda bemillin setimin. veillen innun kochavayya, dinhirin leistakkela go mazzale, bitsirin illain.

Etzbean kayyme berazin illain. tufere etzbean, dekayymin dechafyan, levar, hu ukemuha beinnun razin, dahavo (Bereshit 21 amud alef) panim dilvar, uvehu it razin, leinun charashin, demistachle betufere, binhiru demilla achara, deshalta behu, veinnun charashin ka mesaave lehahu atar.

Betuferin it zimnin, denaharin behu kochavin chivvavrin dekikin, veillen innun ketolda ditlufechin, veinnun shekiin kehay masmera al lucha. velav innun keinnun chivvavrin acharanin dela shekiin, ella dekayymin leella. behani dela shekiin, let behu mammasha. aval hani dishkiin chivvavrin ketolda ditlufechin it behu mammasha, veit simana tava leh levar nash bechedu (nusach acher 13) veyatzlach behahu zimna. o gezera itgezar alleh veishteziv minah.
650: (Sharetavetayn) beetzbean lego. beyadin sirtutin ravrevin, sirtutin zeirin dekikin illain bimina. beinnun etzbean divhu sirtutin zeirin. beetzbea zeera dimina, it reshimin dekikin. etzbea da, kayyeyma tadir al ovadin devistar achara.

Behay etzbea kayymin sirtutin, innun deetzbea itkefil behu. hane lav innun leistakkela, ella i ittosfan beh. i ittosfan teren ochoranin, al hahu sirtuta deitkefal behu. archa la izdaman leh. vei yaavod la yitzlach.

Bar i kayyman bearka, ben reshima lirshima, bezimna deyitmeshach mashcha laachora, veishtaaru innun reshimin deishtemodan. hay yitzlach bearcha. vesiman da, telat telat befuteya. vearba bearka. veraza da 7 meatvavn zeirin.

Reshima chad bearka, uteren teren befuteya. mearcha, yishma millin bizman kariv, velet leh behu toalta. arba reshimin bearka, ved reshimin befuteya, archa izdaman leh betorach saggi, ulesofa letoaltay. veraza da 7 meatvavn emtzaiyyin, deven zeirin veravrevin.

Chamesh zeirin reshimin befuteya letatta, vearba befuteya leella, vearba bearka. nayycha leh beveteh, veatzla ihu. vearcha havat metatkena kameh, vela bae lemebad. vei yaavod, yitzlach behahu archa, aval la avid leh, veatzla have veraza da 7 deihi peshuta.

Beetzbea deemtzaita, hay etzbea kayyeyma, lemebad ovada hahu dechashiv. i sirtuta chada kayyeyma bearka, ben sirtute defuteya, hay chashav machashavin, veistallekan minneh, vedachil vela avid, vehahi machashava la itavid kelal.

I teren sirtutin bearka, dekayymin kad itpashat mashcha laachora. hay lav beh machashavin, vechashiv machashavin lefum shaata, veitavid, vela machashava dehirher beh kelal, ella machashava deihu bivhilu uzeira, aval hirhura umachashava la.

Vei telat reshimin bearka. uvefuteya teren o telat, kad itpashat mashcha laachora. hay ihu bar nash deihu pekicha, vechashiv machashavin, vechol innun machashavin deinnun listar kudesha berich hu itkayyeyman bideh, umachashavin acharanin lav hachi.

I arba o chamishsha bearka, beitpeshatu demashcha kidkamran, (da ihu) kad sharan al puteya, bitlat, o bearba, o mitteren ulehala. da bar nash demachashavoy leavasha, veishtavach behu. vedikni ugevine enoy sumakin, mechashshev levish veishtabbach behu. kitzra deyomin ihu. pekicha ihu. veachna tadir limchilan devish. atzlach. ulesofa deyomin zeirin istallak mealma.

Asvavta lehay tiyyuveta. keden ishtechachu telat reshimin, o arba, vesharyayn al teren. telat reshimin o 4 bearka vesharyayn al teren befuteya. deha kefum minhaga devar nash, hachi mitchallefe sirtutin, mizzeman lizman. veraza da (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam vegomer, merov onim veammitz koach vegomer.

Kema dekudesha berich hu achlaf chayyaylin uzemanin bechochve shemaya, yoma da kach, uleyoma achara kach. (veda ihu deamrinan bitzlota dearvit umachalif et hazzemannim umesadder et hakkochavim kefum dachelavepaa dazemaneym kach ihu misseder kochavim.) kefum deadam dilgo kol ovadoy. hachi itchazun behay rekia. vehachi itchaze behay mashcha dehay adam tattaa. deihu rekia, or dechafya al kolla.

Vecholla kefum gavvna deadam dilgo, dehay lezimnin kaim bedina, lezimnin berachame, kehahu gavvna mammash achze levar. lezimnin kehay gavvna, ulezimnin kehay gavvna kegavvna da letatta behay adam, kema deamaran, lezimnin kehay gavvna, ulezimnin kehay gavvna, veraza da at 7 itkelil beh at 10.
651: Dimina, bizera uveravreva. vesiman (Devarim 1:17) kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun. ellu teren etzbean berazin illen, vehachi innun berazin deolifna minneh demor, (velo inun) beraze derav yesa sava. mikkan ulehala sirtutin acharanin, deikrun kullehu toldot, veinnun toldot adam, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) toldot hashshamayim, veha ittemar, decholla raza da. kegavvna da toldot adam, bechol innun diyyukenin deanpin, uvechol innun dekaamaran. uveillen toldot desirtute yedin, deitchazyayn berazin penimain, kema deitchaze.
Ze sefer toldot adam, lesirtutin, siman 212 230. razin lechakkime libba, 352, chamesh atvavn, bechamesh tarin, leminda chachma besucheltanu.

Tara kadmaa, Rabbi. bida it sirtutin dekikin, vesirtutin ravrevin. vechullehu mitarve da im da. sirtutin ravrevin deit bida, kad innun teren bearka, uteren befuteya, veachidu da beda, da ihu beraza deat Adonai, uveraza deat Rabbi vedache leat 7, venatil illen teren atvavn. befuteya natil Adonai, bearka natil Rabbi, vesiman dileh 205.

Da it leh bida semala kehay gavvna beillen sirtutin ravrevin. aval innun sirtutin zeirin denatla yemina, la natla semala. dimina natla, chad sirtuta dakik leella bearka, vechad sirtuta dakik letatta, deachid ben innun teren sirtutin ravrevan. befuteya it chad sirtuta dakik, deachid letatta beinnun teren desharya aleh. uvismala lav hachi, veraza dileh ihu bimina, velav bismala.

Hay ihu bar nash, dilzimnin taiv beveta, ulezimnin bearcha, da la shachich libbeh behay uvehay. kad ihu beveta taiv bearcha, vechad ihu bearcha, taiv beveta. atzlach tadir bearcha, ulezimnin beveta. da atzlach beorayyta, uveraze deorayyta i ishtedal behu. hay chame besanoy, toalta lesaggiin beh. atzla ihu bemille dealma. i ittear, ittearun leotava leh milleella. zache bemilloy. da ihu chamida umefazzer mamona. tav ena ihu. tzeloteh ishtema. nachit vesalik bemamona.

Da ihu dilzimnin mittebar libbeh legabbeh mareh. ucheden ishtechachu telat sirtutin zeirin, dimabberan behahu sirtuta dakik, deittosaf al innun teren defuteya, veraza da Adonai demitchabbera im Rabbi. da archa, da beta. da chedva, da atzivu, da toalta, da atzla, da tav ena, da chamida, umefazzer mamona. da mittebar libbeh, vetav lemareh.

Tara tinyayna, 7. bimina, bekastiru dekolta, reshimin shechiche, kad ishtechachu telat sirtutin ravrevin befuteya, uteren ravrevin bearka, vechad meinnun dearka, achid beinnun teren defuteya, vechad achara la achid behu. hay it paslu bezareh, missitra daavoy, o missitra deimmeh.

Ucheden mishtakkeche letatta meinnun telat sirtutin defuteya, teren sirtutin dekikin, daachidan behu letatta. hay ihu bar nash, metakken ovadoy, kame bene nasha, velibbeh la keshot. ulezimna desiv, ahdar leittakna. keden ishtechachu innun teren sirtutin bearcha, achidan beinun defuteya, da im da. uteren acharanin imhon beemtzaita, dekikin, veda bearka. utelat dekikin befuteya, veraza da 7 demitchabbera beat Rabbi.

Vechad ihu siv vetav kidkamran, ittakkan ihu beraza deat Rabbi, veitchabbar beat 7. levatar kad hay ittakkan, ihu tadir bilchishu, vechol ovadoy bilchishu. aval lav ihu bekiyyuma kadka chazi begin dehahu paslu, ad la ityayasha beh. (mikkan olifna man defasil zareh ad telat darin lo ateyyashea hahu pesilu 0 malekashekashea. begin kach tanenan vavy leh lehahu bar nash defasal zareh velo chayish likara demareh. pasil zareh vadday.)
652: Ulevatar deityayasha. hahu pesilu, keden ishtechachu sirtutin bida yemina, arba vechamesh. arba bearka, chamesh befuteya. veraza da 7, veitchabbar beat Adonai. hay lezimnin atzlach, lezimnin la atzlach. atzlach beorayyta, ulesof yomoy, atzlach afillu bemamona.
Tara telitaa, Adonai. bimina, kad ishtechachu chamesh sirtutin befuteya, utelat bearka, veishtechach hahu sirtuta deemtzaita meinnun telat, da ihu beraza deat Adonai, veistemich beot 60.

Bezimna deishtechach hahu sirtuta deemtzaita, deal veachid go innun chamesh sirtutin defuteya, da ihu bar nash atziv veragiz go beteh, uvego bene nasha lav hachi. kamtzan ihu beveteh, veragiz vechafin, ulezimnin la. levar mibbeteh lav hachi. atzlach beovde alma. kad ishtaddal beorayyta istakkil zeer veithaddar bah. mehemana ihu, aval lav kol zimna. vehahu zimna delav mehemana, achze gon keshot, vela keshot bishlimu. bedina yitzlach. mehemana ihu berazin deorayyta, da ihu beraza deat Adonai, veitchabbar beat 60.

Vei arba sirtutin befuteya, vechamesh bearka, teren meinnun dearka, alin go innun arba, da ihu bar nash chadde beveteh, veitchazze atziv libba levar, velav hachi dechevan demallil im bene nasha, achze chedu veitkevavn bemilloy.

Telat sirtutin zeirin alin go innun dearka, da it leh chad reshimu ucham begufeh, utelat saarin talyayn behahu reshimu, vehahu reshimu ihu keiggula, vechad tevira (chibbura) beresheh. ulehay reshima, karan leh chakkime libba, deyadin razin illen, resh nishra. reshimu da, itchaze lezimnin, ben kitfoy. ulezimnin, bidroa yemina. ulezimnin, al yeda yemina beetzbeoy.

I reshima da resh nishra, ihu beorach meshar betikunoy, yistallak leutera velikara. vei hahu resh nishra ithappach laachora, yizke levenin lezimnin. aval kad ihu siv, yizke leutera yattir, velikar sagya, yattir meulemoy, veyatzlach beorayyta, i ishtaddal bah.
Resh nishra da, itchaze lezimnin uchama, ulezimnin gon dela sumak zeer, dela itzteba kol kach. lezimnin besaarin lezimnin sheia, vecholla chad simana ihu, uvechad dina itdan.

Vei hahu gon sumak itzteba yattir, vekaim bigvavneh, zeman zeer hu deitzteva, begin deillen gavvnin, lezimnin kayymin nehirin, ulezimnin chashuchin. vei itzteba hahu sumak venahir, keden it bida semala, telat sirtutin bearka, utelat befuteya, vechad dakik al innun defuteya, vechad dakik al innun dearka. uvida yemina ittosaf chad befuteya bilchodoy. hay bar nash shachiv bennidda, vela tav minne lemareh.

Vechad tav bityuveta, ishtaaru innun sirtutin bida semala, vehahu deittosaf bimina, itade minneh, veitade hahu sumaka, dela itchaze nahir kol kach minneh. ulezimnin deaf al gav detav, la adiu minnih hahu sumaka, ad zeman. hay ihu beraza deat Adonai, veitade at 60, veal techotoy at 90, veitchabbar at Adonai beat 90. hay bae tikkuna lenafsheh bivhilu. chakkima delibba dechame leh, chovata it aleh, lomar leh zil asse lenafshach.

Vei telat sirtutin bearka, vechad befuteya, da ihu beraza deat Adonai bilchodeh. ulezimnin itchabbar beraza deat 7. hay ihu bar nash taiv batar bitzin dealma. vei lav, radif batar nashin, veteuveteh niufim. veaf al gav detaiv levitzin dealma, hay la adiv minneh, vela achsif. enoy shekiin umallil behu.
I tav lemareh mitchallefe sirtutin. telat befuteya vechad learka, veinnun teren dekikin
653: Kayymin bekiyyuma, keden reu dileh yattir beitteteh, veitdevak bah. chad dakik yattir, al ben innun teren dekikin. keden itchabbar at Adonai beat 7.

Vei sirtuta chad bearka vearba befuteya, utelat dekikin kayymin al hahu chad, vechad al innun arba. al deroa semala, it leh telat kisterin dekikin, deityelidu beh miyyomin zeirin, vechad saara talya, behahu chad deresha. hay ihu radif batar neufa deeshet chavreh. mareh dizdona ihu. agzim beena semala, bela millula kalal, veashlim. uvegin deihu marih zedona, la chayish likara demareh, leatava kameh. levatar katil chivya leh, o bar nash sumaka.

Vei arba bearka, utelat befuteya, veinnun desallekin leella adiu minneh. hay, tavar libbeh legabbe mareh, vetav betiuveta. keden ihu beraza deat 80, veitchabbar beat Adonai. al illen, veal innun dichvavteh, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 57:19) shalom shalom larachok velakkarov.

Ad hacha, kol innun razin detoldot adam, deinnun toldot, deityelidu beh mizzeman lizman, kefum archoy devar nash. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun deyatvin kameh demor, vezachu lemishma mippumeh razin deorayyta. zakkaa innun behay alma, vezakkain innun lealma deate. amar Rabbi shimon, zakkain attun chavrayya, dechol razin la anis lechu, kamma duchetin illain izdammenan lechu lealma deate.

Patach veamar (Shemot 18:21) veatta techoze mikkol haam anshe chayil yire elohim anshe emet sone vatza, hay kera ukemuha. aval veatta techoze, tivchar la ketiv. ella techoze: lefum chezu deayynin. bemay. bediyyukena devar nash beillen shit sitrin dekaamartun vecholla behay kera. veatta techoze, chad, besara. mikkol haam, teren, bemitzcha. anshe chayil, telat, beanpin. yire elohim, arba, beayynin. anshe emet, chamesh, beshifvavn. sone vatza, shit, beyadin. besirtutehon.

Deillen innun simanin, leishtemoda behu beni nasha, leinun deruach chachmeta sharya alayyhu. veim kol da, moshe la itzterich da, ella ma ketiv, vayyivchar moshe anshe chayil mikkol yisrael. begin derucha kudesha hava ate legabbeh, veoda leh, uveh hava chame kolla.

Mena lan, dichtiv ki yihye lahem davar ba elay. baim elay la ketiv, ella ba elay, da ruach kudesha, dehava ate legabbeh, uveh hava yada, vela itzterich lechol da leistakkela uleayyna, ella lefum shaata hava yada moshe.

Kehay gavvna, yada shelomo malka, yada bechuresyeh, deruach kudesha sharya aleh, dechol man dekariv lechuresyeh, dechilu veemata nafil aleh, uveh hava dain dina bela sahadin. begin dediyyukenin havo bechuresyeh, vechol man demikrav beshikra, mechashkesha hahu diyyukena, vahava yada shelomo malka, divshikra kaate. begin kach, emata dechuresye hava nafil al kolla, vechullehu ishtechachu zakkain kameh.

Malka meshicha berecha, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 11:3) vaharicho beyirat Adonai velo lemare enav yishpot vegomer. utelat illen, danu alma, bela sahadin vehateraa. shear bene alma al pum sahadin, al memar orayyta. chakkimin deishtemodan beinnun diyyukenin, alayyhu leazhara livne alma, ulemehav asvavta livne nasha, uleasse nafshayyhu. zakkain innun behay alma, vezakkain innun bealma deate.
654: Veihu raza deish tam, mareh deveta, ish haelohim. tam: detamman siyyuma vekishra ditfilin, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam hava. uvediyyukeneh, kayyeyma raza dechashmal penimaa illaa tamir veganiz. vechol nehorin setimin illain nakit ihu, venafke minneh, vechullehu mashreyayn nakte innun maftechan dehahu nehora denafik miggo chashmal.

Vehahu nehora, kalil bitren nehorin, veinnun chad. nehora kadmaa, ihu nehora chivvavra, dela shalta beh ena, veda ihu nehora deganiz letzaddikayyay. kema deat amer (Tehillim 97:11) or zarua latztzaddik vegomer. nehora tinyayna, ihu nehora menatztzetza melahata, kegavavn sumak. veitkelilu teren nehorin kechad, vahavu chad.

Vehay 248 rav memana, vechol innun mashiryayn, natle hahu nehora, uvegin dechalil bitren, ikre teomim. veal da shalta beh, hahu mazzala deikre beraza dileh teomim, uveh ityehivat orayyta. umikkan itmashshechan dargin letatta, ad desallekin bishmahan, (sefer acher leanhaga) leanhara alma.

Kol shear mazzale, let lon pe velashon, vehay it leh pe velashon kelilan kachada. veal da beorayyta, (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam velayla ketiv. yomam, lokovel lashon. layla, lokovel pe. vecholla kalil kachada. uvecholla salik teomim.

Tomim ketiv, veal raza da ketiv tomim, (Bereshit 25:24) vehinne tomim bevitnah. i tema divgin tarvavyyhu kaamar. lav hachi, deha esav la salik beraza da. ella begin yaakov kaamar, ushevacha da, dehava bimaha dehahi tzaddeket, ka meshabbach kera. uvegin dehava tamman hahu rasha, istallak mittamman alef.

Vecholla raza chada. yaakov natil beraza dileh, teren yarchin 170 227, veitkelil ihu beraza desivan, deihu teomim. esav, natil beraza dileh, teren yarchin tammuz av, veihu la ishtechach, veitavid, deha elul lav dileh hu, vaafillu av, 9 yom innun dileh, vela yattir, veitavid, vela ishtechach, velav ihu beraza ditomim, ella itperash lechodeh, vesata lesitra achara baafisa ushemamu, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 9:7) haoyev tammu choravot lanetzach.

Uvegin deyaakov ihu teomim, ityehivat orayyta livnoy bachodesh teomim, veorayyta beraza ditomim, tora shebbichtav, vetora shebbeal pe. bachodesh telitae, leam telitae, bedargin telitain, tora telitae: tora, neviim, uchetuvim. vecholla chad.

Bachodesh hashelishi vegomer. parsheta da behay kera ukemuha leh leella. tani rabbi chiyyay, behahu zimna dematu yisrael letura desinay, kanish lehu kudesha berich hu lezariyn deyisrael, veashgach leh bechullehu, vela ashkach bechullehu zara deyisrael paslu, ella kullehu zara kaddisha, kullehu bene keshot.

Behahu zimna amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, hasheta ana bae lemehav orayyta leyisrael, mashich lehu birchimuta daavahan, birchimuta derachimna lehu, uveatvavn daavadit lehu. veat have li shelucha, veativ millin illen. amar Rabbi yosi amar Rabbi yehuda, kach amar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, bemilla da hve li shelicha mehemana, leamshacha yisrael avatray.

(Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar vegomer. umoshe ala el haelohim, leatra difrisan gadpoy dishchinta, kema deat amer (Tehillim 18:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad vegomer.

Tana amar Rabbi yehuda, kol zimna diglufe malka illaa mityashsheran beatrayyhu, almin kullehu bechidu, vechol ovadin mityashsheran bekiyyumayyhu. (man kol ovadin mateyysharen bekiyyumayyhu) kema deat amer, (Shemot la) et maase Adonai ki nora hu. may ki nora hu. amar Rabbi elazar, shelimu decholla. kema deat amer (Devarim 10:17) hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora. may
655: Vehannora. da yaakov. uchetiv, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam, ketargumo, gevar shelim. shelim becholla. kach kol ovadin dekudesha berich hu, shelemin bishlimu, bekiyyuma shelim.

Tanya, rabbi yosi omer, yoma chad hava kaimna kameh der yehuda sava, shailna leh, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:17) vayyira vayyomar ma nora vegomer. may ka chama, dekaamar deihu nora. amar li, chama shelimu dimhemanuta kaddisha, dehava shechiach behahu atar, kegavvna dilella. uvechol atar dehavi shelemuta shechiach, ikre nora.

Amena leh, i hachi, amay targumo dechilu, vela shelim. amar li, let dechilu ella beatar dehavy shelemuta shechiach, uvechol atar dehavy shelemuta shechiach, itkere nora. dichtiv, (tehillim la) yerou et Adonai kedoshav ki en machsor lireav, mimmashma dekaamar ki en machsor, baatar delet machsor, shelemuta shechiach.

Tana (Mishlei 30:4) mi ala shamayim vayyerad, amar Rabbi yosi, da hu moshe, dichtiv umoshe ala el haelohim. mi asaf ruach bechafnav, da hu aharon. dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:12) umelo chafnav ketoret sammim dakka. mi tzarar mayim bassimla, da eliyyahu. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:1) im yihye hashshanim haelle tal umatar ki im lefi devari. mi hekim kol afse aretz, da hu avraham. dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, al tikre behibbaram, ella beavraham.

Hu tane hay, vehu amar, mi ala shamayim, da kudesha berich hu. dichtiv beh (Tehillim 47:6) ala elohim bitrua (mi ala tikkun besod et haur amnam bitrua vayyered besod vayyavdel, hivdilu lo elohim bitrua) mi asaf ruach bechafnav, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Iyov 12:10) asher beyado nefesh kol chay vegomer. mi tzarar mayim bassimla da kudesha berich hu. dichtiv beh (Iyov 26:8) tzorer mayim beavav. mi hekim kol afse aretz, da kudesha berich hu. dichtiv beh, (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. tu amar, mi ala shamayim vayyerad vegomer, illen innun arba ketire alma, esh ruach mayim veafar.

Amar Rabbi yesa, itchazun milloy der yosi, dela mitkayyeyman. kad matu millin illen legabbeh der shimon, anach yedoy beresheh der yosi uvarcheh, veamar shappir ka amart, vehachi hu. amar leh mena lach. amar hachi olifna meabba, dehava amar mishshemeh derav hamenuna sava.

Yoma chad hava yativ Rabbi shimon betara detzippori, amar leh Rabbi yesa, hay deamar Rabbi yosi, mi ala shamayim vayyerad vegomer, zimna chada amar, da moshe. levatar amar, da kudesha berich hu. levatar amar, illen 4 ketirin esh ruach mayim veafar. vachamena leh lemor devarcheh.

Amar leh vadday shappir ka amar, vehachi hu, vecholla chad milla, vechullehu mille itkayymu bekudesha berich hu, vechullehu bechad matkela salleka. itregish Rabbi yesa bemilloy der shimon, veamar vadday hay hachi hu, vehachi olifna mikkameh demor zimna achara. (elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, el tikre behibbaram, ella beavraham. dichtiv, 0 ki amarti olam chesed yivne. aval)

Vecholla shappir. aval sofa dikra may ka mayyre dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:4) ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda. ma shemo tinach, ma shem beno mahu. amar leh, raza demilla ha olifna lera elazar beri. amar leh, lema li mor, deha bechelmi shailna kameh demor hay milla, veamar li, vaanshina lah. amar leh, i ema tidkar. amar leh vadday. deha ma deolifna kame demor yoma da adkarna.

Amar leh raza demilla, hayeynu dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael uchetiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar. uveraza illaa, vehay ikre beno. amar yanuch dateh demor, deha raza da yedana. adhachi, la idkar Rabbi yesa, chalash dateh, azal leveteh, admuch, achziu leh bechelma, chad sifra deaggadta, dehava ketiv beh, chachma vetiferet bemikdasho.
Ittear, azil legabbeh derabbi shimon, nashak yedoy, amar, hachi chamena bechelma. zimna achara chamena bechelma, chad
656: Sifra deaggadta deachziu kamay, vahava ketiv beh, chachma vetiferet bemikdasho, chachma leella, tiferet letatta. bemikdasho legabbayyhu. vehachi chamena bechelma zimna chada. vehachi ashkachna befumay. amar leh Rabbi shimon, ad kean ravya ant, lemeal ben mechatztzede chakla, veha kolla achziu lach. veda hu dichtiv, ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda. chachma shemo, tiferet beno.

(451) (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim, zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dezache likara da, deorayyta ashid begineh kach. (tane Rabbi yehuda) ta chaze, ma ben moshe lishar beni alma. shear bene alma, kad sallekin, sallekin leutra, sallekin lirbu, sallekin lemalchu, aval moshe kad salik, ma ketiv beh, umoshe ala el haelohim, zakkaa chulakeh.
Rabbi yosi amar, mikkan amru chavrayya, habba litaher mesayyeyin oto, dichtiv umoshe ala el haelohim. ma ketiv batreh, vayyikra elav Adonai. deman devae leitkarva, mekarvin leh.

Vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar lemor ko tomar levet yaakov vegomer. Rabbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha, zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, dekudesha berich hu itree beh, vekariv leh, lemishre bego hechala kaddisha, dechol man deihu itree beh lefulechaneh, rashim hu mershimin dilella, leminda deha hu itbachar mikkameh demalka kaddisha illaa, lemishre bimdoroy. vechol man deishtechach beh hahu reshima, abar bechol tarin dilella, velet deyimche bidoy.

Rabbi yehuda amar, zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dealeh ketiv ashre tivchar utekarev, uchetiv beh (Shemot 24:2) umoshe niggash el haarafel veniggash moshe levaddo el Adonai vehem lo yigashu. ko tomar levet yaakov: illen nukeve, vetagged livni yisrael: illen ducherin.

Rabbi shimon amar, ko tomar, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 6:23) ko tevarachu. uchetiv, (Tehillim 145:10) vachasidecha yevarachucha, kelomar yevarchu ko. ko tomar levet yaakov, baamira. vehayeynu missitra dedina. vetagged livne yisrael, kema deat amer, (Devarim 4:13) vayyagged lachem et berito. uchetiv (Devarim 26:3) higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha. livne yisrael, ducherin, deatu missitra derachame.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, (sefer acher yose) hoil vaatena lehay, ma hu higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha. laAdonai elohenu, mibbae leh. amar leh Rabbi shimon, vechi hay bilchodoy hu. veha ketiv (Devarim 8:7) ki Adonai elohecha meviacha el eretz tova vegomer. (Devarim 7:16) asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu, vechullehu hachi.

Ella hachi tanenan, kol haddar beeretz yisrael dome kemi sheyyesh lo eloah. vechol haddar bechutza laaretz dome kemi sheen lo eloah. may taama. mishshum dezara kaddisha, leara kaddisha salleka. ushechinta beatra yatva. vehay behay talya. umoshe la kaamar elohecha, ella leinun dahavo zeminin lemeal leara kaddisha, ulekabbela appe shechinta. uma dela amar elohenu, mishshum deha moshe la zacha lemeal leara, uvegini kach, elohecha vadday bechol atar, mishshum deinnun havo zeminin lemeal tamman.

Amar leh vday hachi hu. aval hacha ketiv, (Devarim 26:3) uveat el hakkohen asher yihye bayyamim hahem veamarta elav higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha, veha innun beara sharyayn, may taama elohecha, velo elohenu. ella innun bayayn leachazaa uleodaa, divgine dechesed illaa, zachan lechol hay, vesharyayn beara, veaalan lehahi ara, veavid immehon kol innun tavan, uvegine kach, havo amri millin illen lakkohen, (velo levar nash achara) dichtiv higgadti hayyom laAdonai elohecha, (vehachi hu vadday) mishshum deate missitra dechesed.

Ko tomar levet yaakov, lehahu atar deitchaze lehu. vetagged livne yisrael, behahu atar shelim deitchaze lehu, deha yaakov veyisrael, teren dargin istalaku, uvedarga chad sallekin, ella yisrael shelemuta decholla
657: Ikre. vetagged livni yisrael, leachazaa chachmeta, uleishtae beruach chachmeta, tivu ukeshot deavad lon kudesha berich hu, dichtiv vayyagged lachem et berito.

Tanya, amar Rabbi yosi, zimna chada havena azil bearcha, vahava Rabbi chiyyay beri immi. ad dahavena azlin, ashkachna chad gevar, dehava lakit bechakla, asavin leasvavta. karivna legabbeh, amena leh, bar nash, kutera dekutere daasavin lamma. la zakif resheh, vela amar midi. ahadarna zimna achara vaamena hay, vela amar midi. amena leh lerabbi chiyyay beri, o hay bar nash atim udenin, o shatya, o chakkima. yativna gabboy. levatar lakit innun asavin, veachid lon, vechafa alehon tarpe gufenin.

Amar lan, ana chamena deyudain atun, veyudain amre alayyhu, deinnun chakkimin, i la dechayyisna alayychu hasheta, tehevon rechikin mibbene nasha kisgira da, demarchikin leh mikkolla, deha ana chamena, derecha dechad isba dehava kariv gabbechon, al begufayychu, vetehevon rechikin telata yomin. ella achilu illen tume bara vetitsun,

Achalna minnayyhu dahavo shechichin kamman, veadmachna, veitkatarna bezea, ad iddan saggi. levatar ittearna, amar lan hahu gavra, hasheta elahachon immechon, deashkachtun li, deha asvavta degufechon al yedi ishtelim.

Ad dahavena azlin, amar lan, kol bar nash bae leishtee bevar nash achara, kefum archoy, deha lenukeba kefum archoy. legavra kefum archoy. legavra degavre kefum archoy. amena lerabbi chiyyay beri, hayeynu dichtiv, ko tomar levet yaakov vetagged livni yisrael. (sefer acher ko tomar levet yaakov behahu atar deitchaze lehu. vetagged livne yisrael behahu atar shelim deitchaze lehu. deha yaakov veyisrael teren dargin inun uvedarga chad sallekin ella yisrael shelemuta divlo ikre)

Amar lan, chamitun dela zakifna reshay, vela ishtaena bahadayychu, mishshum deabba, chakkima baasavin mikkol beni dara hava. veolifna meabba archoy dechol asavin, dibbehon keshot, vaana bechol shatta madoray benayyhu.

Vehay isba dachamitun, dachafena leh betarpe degufenin illen, bevetay it atar chad, vehu listar tzafon, uvehahu atar naitz chad rechayya, umeena dehahu rechayya, nafik chad gevar bitren reshin, vecharba shinana bideh uvechol yoma ka metzaer lan. vaana lakitna hay isba, vezilu avatray, vetechomun cheleh dehay isba, uma di elaha illaa galle bealma, velet man deyeda archoy becholla.

Azilna avatreh, ad dahavena azle bearcha, maich lechad nukeba beafra, veshavve mehahu isba benukeva, nafak chad chivya veresha dileh saggi. natal chad santira, (nusach acher sudara) vekatir leh kechad gadya. dachilna. amar lon zilu avatray.
Ad dematena leveteh. chamena hahu atar bechashocha, batar chad kotala. natal chad sharga vedalik deleka sacharanih dehahu atar derechayya. amar lon, mimma detechemun, la tidchalun vela tishtaun midi.

Adhachi, share chivya mikkitroy, vechatash bekista mehahu isba. veshavve beresheh dechivya. al chivya behahu ena derechayyay, ushemana kala dechol atar mizdazea. baenan lemefak, achid bidana hahu gavra, amar, la tidchalun kerivu gabbay.

Adhachi, nafak chivya shatit dama, nakit hahu gavra mehahu isba, veshavve beresheh kivkadmeta. al behahu ena derechayya. leshaata zeira, chamena, denafik mehahu ena chad gavra bitren reshin, vechivya sharyay sacharaneh dekidloy. al behahu ena derechayya venafak telat zimne. hava amar, zekita zekita, vavy leimeh dilhahu atar ovil leh.

Adhachi, itteakar rechayya meatreh, venafku, gavra vechivya, venaflu umitu tarvavyyhu. vaanan dachilna saggi. amar lan hahu gavra, da hu chela deisba daana lakitna kamayychu, uvegine kach la ishtaena bahadayychu, vela zakifna reshay, beshaata dekarivtun gabbay.
658: Yadin bene nasha chachmeta, dechol ma denata kudesha berich hu beara, vechela dechol ma deishtechach bealma, yishtemodun chela demarehon, bechachmateh saggia. aval la tamir kudesha berich hu chachmeta da mibbene nasha, ella begin dela yistun mearchoy, vela yitrechitzu behahi chachmeta veyinshun leh.

Kad atena, vaamena hane mille kameh derabbi shimon, amar vadday chakkima hava. veta chaze, let isba veisba deityeylid beara, dela hava beh chachmeta saggia, vecheleh bishmayya sagya. ta chaze, min ezova. divchol atar devae kudesha berich hu ledakkea lebar nash, (vaychi 250 amud alef) beezova mitdache. may tama. mishshum deyittear cheleh dilella deitpakkeda aloy, deha hahu chela deitpakkeda aloy kad itteara, mevaara ruach mesaava, veitdakke bar nash. vealach amena berich rachamana deshezvach.

(Shemot 19:4) attem reitem asher asiti lemitzrayim veeshsha etchem al kanfe nesharim. may kanfe nesharim. amar ribbi yehuda berachame. dichtiv, (Devarim lak) kenesher yair kinno vegomer. vehayeynu raza deamar Rabbi shimon, (Mishlei 30:19) derech hannesher bashshamayim. may bashshamayim. berachame. ma nesher ishtechach berachame al benoy, vedina legabbe acharanin. kach kudesha berich hu ishtechach berachame legabbe yisrael, vedina legabbe ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot.

Rabbi elazar, hava azil mikkapputekiyya lelud, vahava azil Rabbi yose ver chiyyay immeh, kamu binhora, kad nahir yemama, vahavu azle. amar Rabbi chiyyay, chamena hay kera dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:10) ufene arye el hayyamin learbatan ufene shor mehassemol learbatan ufene nesher learbatan ha arye bimina, shor missemala, (120 amud alef) nesher bean atar ducheteh.

Amar leh Rabbi elazar, beatra (nusach acher deyaakov) deyanika sharya. may tama. mishshum denesher becholla ishtechach, rachame livnoy, dina legabbe acharanin. kach kudesha berich hu, ovil lon leyisrael berachame. uvedina legabbe acharanin, dichtiv veeshsha etchem al kanfe nesharim. uchetiv kenesher yair kinno.

Menalan denesher rachame ikre. dichtiv derech hannesher bashshamayim. bashshamayim mammash. uvegine kach arye limina. shor lismala. nesher benayyhu veachid lon. adam kalil kullehu, vecholla itteklilan beh, dichtiv veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala.

Vayhi vayyom hashelishi vegomer. Rabbi abba patach, (Shir HaShirim 8:8) achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah ma naase laachotenu bayyom sheyyedubbar bah. achot lanu ketanna, da keneset yisrael, deikre achot lekudesha berich hu. veshadayim en lah, hayeynu detanenan, beshaata dekarivu yisrael letura desinay, la hava behon zachvavn, veovadin tavin, leaggana alayyhu, dichtiv veshadayim en lah. deha innun tikkuna ushefiru deitteta, velet shappiru deitteta ella innun. ma naase laachotenu. ma yitavid minah, beshaata dekudesha berich hu, yitgele betura desinay, lemallela befitgame orayyta, veyifrach nishmathon minayyhu.

Amar Rabbi yose. behahu shaata dekarivu yisrael letura desinay, behahu lelya venaghe, telata yomin dela izdavvevgu leintetayyhu, atu malachin illain, vekabbilu leyisrael beachvavta. innun malachin leella, veyisrael malachin letatta. innun mekaddeshin shema illaa leella, veyisrael mekaddeshin shema illaa letatta.

Veitatteru yisrael beshivin kitrin behahu lelya. umalache illae havo amre achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah, delet behu zachvavn veovadin tavin. ma naase laachotenu, kelomar ma yekar urevu navid leachatana da beyoma dekudesha berich hu yitgele betura desinay lemehav lehu orayyta.
Vayhi vayyom hashelishi, ketiv hyu nechonim lishloshet yamim al tiggeshu el ishsha vehayeynu vayyom hashelishi. Rabbi shimon amar, beshaata dekudesha berich hu baa leitgallaa
659: Betura desinay, kara kudesha berich hu lechol pamalyay dileh, amar lon, hasheta yisrael ravyayn, dela yadin nimusay, vaana bae leitgele alayyhu, i itgele alayyhu bechela digvura, la yachlin lemisbal. aval itgele alayyhu berachame, vikabbelun nimusay, hada hu dichtiv, vayhi vayyom hashelishi. vayyom hashelishi vadday deihu rachame menalan. dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad.
Uvehay itgele kudesha berich hu leyisrael, akdim lehu rachame bekadmita. ulevatar ityeyhiv lehu orayyta, missitra digvura. vayyom hashelishi, dehachi itchaze lehu, divgine kach yisrael ikrun.

Bihyot habboker, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 23:4) boker lo avot. ha i hava avot kadruta ishtechach, vela itgalleyay chesed. veematay itgalleyay chesed. babboker. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 45) habboker or. dechad nahir tzafra, chesed ishtechach bealma, vedinin mitabberan. uvezimna dela nahir boker, dinin ad kean la mitabberan. dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve boker vayyariu kol bene elohim. kevan deitabberan innun kochavayya venahir shimsha, beh shaata ketiv, boker lo avot. vechesed ittear bealma tattaa, behahi shaata ketiv, bihyot habboker. vechevan demitabberan kochavayya boker ishtechach. (nusach acher deittear bakar, dinin lo ishtechachu)
Amar Rabbi yose, bihyot habboker share kudesha berich hu leitgallaa betura desinay. tana, bihyot habboker, kad ittear zechuteh deavraham, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 19:27) vayyashkem avraham babboker.
Vayhi kolot uverakim, amar rabbi abba, kolot ketiv chaser. teren kalin deahadru lechad, da nafka min da, rucha mimmayya. umayya merucha. teren deinnun chad, vechad deihu tere.

Amar rabbi yose, kolot chad, veihu kala ravreva takkifa, dela paskat lealmin, hahu dichtiv beh (Devarim Adonai:19) kol gadol velo yasaf deha shear kalin itpassekan, detanya, bearbaa tekufin bashatta, kala itpassekat, ucheden dinin mitarin bealma. vehay kala dechalil shear kalin beh, la itpesak lealmin, vela itavar mikkoyyuma shelim vetukepa dileh. tana, hay kala, kala dekalin, kala dechalil kol shear kalin.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, let kala, ella missitra derucha umayya veeshsha. vecholla (davar achar vecholla) avid kala, veitkelil da beda, veal da ketiv kolot. uverakim, amar ribbi yose, hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 135:7) berakim lammatar asa, shalhova beutere, ketira derachame bechibbata, dela (shakeya) shechichu.

Tana, Rabbi yehuda omer, bistar gevura, orayyta ityeyhivat. amar rabbi yose, i hachi bistar semala havi. amar leh, ithaddar limina. dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. uchetiv (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach vegomer. ashkechan semala deitchazzar limina, vimina lismala, ha gevura lismala (davar achar limina).

Veanan kaved al hahar vegomer, anana takkif, dishkia beatreh, dela natil. vekol shofar chazak meod, miggo daanana takkif hava, nafik hahu kala, kema deat amer (Devarim Adonai:20) vayhi keshamachem et hakkol mittoch hachoshech.
Amar rabbi yehuda, telat chashoche havo, dichtiv choshech anan vaarafel. vehahu kala hava nafik penimaa mikkullehu. amar rabbi yose, penimaa decholla hava, deveh ketiv, kol gadol velo yasaf.

Amar Rabbi abba ketiv (Shemot 20:15) vechol haam roim et hakkolot. roim, shomim mibbae leh. ella hachi taninan, innun kalin, havo mitgallefe behahu chashocha vaanana vekabbala, umitchazyayn behu, kema deitchaze gufa, vechaman ma dechaman, veshamin ma deshamin, miggo hahu chashocha vekabbala vaanana, umiggo hahu chezu dahavo chaman, havo nehirin binhiru illaa, veyadin, ma dela yadu darin acharanin, deatu batrayyhu.

Vechullehu, havo chaman appin beappin, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:4) panim befanim dibber Adonai immachem. uman havo chaman. tane rabbi yose, minnehiru deinnun kalan, dela hava kol, dela hava nahir binhiru, demistachle beh kol genizin, vechol temirin, vechol darin deyetun ad malka meshicha. uvegine kach ketiv vechol haam roim et hakkolot, roim
660: Amar rabbi elazar, vechol haam roim. roim: kema daamena, dechamu minnehiru deinnun kalan, ma dela chamu darin batrain acharanin. et hakkolot: kema deat amer, (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai. vaere Adonai, la ketiv, ella et Adonai. uf hacha, vechol haam roim hakkolot lo neemar, ella et hakkolot.

Kegavvna da, et hashshamayim veet haaretz, deha atin divorayyta, leistakkela beorayyta (nusach acher bechachmeta) ityeyhivu. (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha (Mishlei 3:9) kabbed et Adonai mehonecha. vechullehu leitkelala behu milla achara. uf hacha, et hakkolot, leasgaa hahu kala achara letatta, dechanish lon legabbeh, ma denafik minnayyhu, deveh chaman umistakkelan bechachmeta illaa kol ginzin illain, vechol razin temirin usetimin, ma dela itgalleyay ledarin batrain, deatu batrehon, vela ledarin deyetun lealmin, ad zimna deyete malka meshicha. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:8) ki ayin beayin yerau beshuv Adonai tziyyon. veet hallappidim, bekadmita berakim, vehasheta lappidim. kolla chad. aval middeittekanu betikkunoy leitchazaa, itkerun hachi.
Veet kol hashofar. tane rabbi yitzchak, ketiv (Tehillim 62:12) achat dibber elohim shetayim zu shamati, kema deat amer, anochi, velo yihye lecha.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kol bashofar mibbae leh. hashofar lamma. ella, hahu kol deikre shofar. dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:9) vehaavarta shofar terua bachodesh hashshevii beasor lachodesh beyom hakkippurim, beda itbere (itkere) shofar.
Amar ribbi yose, ma shofar, appik kala, eshsha verucha umayya, uf hacha, kolla itkelil behay, umidda nafkin kalin acharanin.
Amar ribbi elazar, kol denafik mishshofar, demashma deshofar chad, vekol nafik minneh, veshshofar bekiumeh shechiach, uvegine kach ketiv, kol hashofar.
Rabbi yehuda amar hachi, kol hashofar, hashofar ketiv chaser, kema deat amer, (Daniel 6:2) shefar kodem daryavesh. (Daniel 4:24) milki yishpar alach. (Daniel 3:32) shefar kodamay lehachavaya.

Rabbi shimon amar, kol hashofar, atra dekala nafik minneh, ikre shofar. tu amar rabbi shimon, ta chaze, kol hashofar: atra dekala, hayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motza pi Adonai yichye haadam. may motza pi Adonai. da kol (sefer acher denafik mishshofar vehay kol) hashofar, hu rav mikkol shear kale tattae, vetakkifa mikkullehu, dichtiv vekol shofar chazak meod, veal kol shear kalin la ittemar chazak meod. (nusach acher amar rabbi shimon) behay kol hashofar talya kolla, veda hu deikre kol gadol, dichtiv kol gadol velo yasaf. veikre (Melachim 1 19:12) kol demama dakka, nehiru devutzine, dehu zach vedakik, vezachich venahir lecholla.

Demama, mahu demama. amar rabbi shimon, devae bar nash lemishtoka minneh, ulemechesam pumeh. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 39:2) amarti eshmera derachay mechato vilshoni eshmera lefi machsom. demama ihi shetuka dela ishtema levar. vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok, dechamu ma dechamu. vayyanuu kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 6:4) vayyanuu ammot hassippim mikkol hakkore.

Tana, ma ketiv beh bichezkel, kad chama gevuran nimuse kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:4) vaere vehinne ruach seara baa vegomer, ruach seara amay. amar ribbi yose, letavra arba malkevavn. amar ribbi yehuda, tannina, rucha rabba, deittear benimuse gevura dilella baa min hatztzafon. mitztzafon la ketiv ella min hatztzafon hahu deishtemoda leella, hahu detamir veganiz leella.

Anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat, dehava achid beh, (sefer acher velo achid, achid besitroy vechulei), vela hava achid besitroy leitteara dina, detanenan, telat zimnin beyoma, yanka hahu dina kashya, bekardite gelifin missitra digvura, hada hu dichtiv veesh mitlakkachat. begin leitteara bealma.
Uma mevassem leh, hahu dichtiv beh venoga lo saviv. dehahu zihara deaschar leh mikkol sitroy, mevassem leh, umatkin leh, begin dela lehve dina kashya, veyechlun bene nasha lemisbeleh.
(Yechezkel 1:4) umittochah keen hachashmal, tana, umittochah: umiggavvav. keen hachashmal, may chashmal. amar ribbi yehuda, (109 amud bet, 203 amud bet, 247 amud alef) chayyot essa memallela.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, chashmal: ma dehava libba leeshsha, dichtiv mittoch haesh keen hachashmal. velo hachashmal mittoch haesh, miggo eshsha deihi lego beeshsha. keen hachashmal deihi batar arba dargin, dichtiv, ruach seara, anan gadol, veesh mitlakkachat, venoga lo
661: Saviv. umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh, hahu dichtiv beh veesh mitlakkachat.

Tanya rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda amar, chamu yisrael hacha, ma dela chama yechezkel ben buzi, vechullehu itdevaku bechachmeta illaa yakkira. chamishsha dargin dekalin, chamu yisrael betura desinay. uvachamishsha dargin illen ityeyhivat orayyta. darga chamishaa hu, dichtiv kol hashofar. yechezkel lokovlehon chama chamishsha dargin deinnun levar meillen, deinnun ruach seara, anan gadol, veesh mitlakkachat, venoga lo saviv, veen hachashmal.

Amar rabbi elazar, beyisrael ketiv, (Devarim Adonai:4) panim befanim dibber Adonai vegomer. bichezkel ketiv, keen, udemut, keman dechame batar kotalin saggiin, keman dechame bar nash batar kotala. amar rabbi yehuda, ma dechamu yisrael, la chama nevia achara, kol shekken ma dechama moshe, dela chama nevia achara. (sefer acher kol shekken bar nash achara) zakkaa chulakeh, dichtiv beh, (Shemot la) vayhi sham im Adonai velo bechezu achara, kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:8) umare velo vechidot.

Amar rabbi yose, ta chaze, ketiv, (Yechezkel 1) (2 1) hayo haya devar Adonai, nevua leshaata hayta. Rabbi yehuda omer, lekiyyuma hu deata, deitzterich lemeheve beginehon deyisrael, leishtemoda deha la shavik lon kudesha berich hu, uvechol atar demitpazrin yisrael begaluta, imhon hu sharya.

Amar rabbi elazar, hayo haya: dechama vela chama, dekaim beinnun millin, vela kaim. hada hu dichtiv vaere keen chashmal, vela chashmal aval yisrael, ma ketiv behu, vechol haam roim et hakkolot, kol chad vechad chama, kadka chaze leh.

Detanya, kol chad vechad havo kayymin shurin shurin, techumin techumin, vechadka itchaze lehu, chamu kol chad vechad. amar rabbi shimon, reshe deamma bilchodayyhu, reshe dishvatin bilchodayyhu. nukeve bilchodayyhu. Adonai dargin limina, vaAdonai dargin lismala. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 29:9) attem nitztzavim hayyom kulchem lifne Adonai elohechem rashechem shivtechem ziknechem veshotrechem kol ish vegomer, ha Adonai dargin limina. vaAdonai dargin lismala man innun. hayeynu dichtiv, (dabeham 29) tappechem, neshechem, vegercha asher bekerev machanycha, mechotev etzecha, ad shoev memecha. ha Adonai dargin lismala.
Kullehu dargin ittakanu kegavvna dilella. lokovlehon yartu yisrael achasanat almin, eser amiran, divhu talyayn kol pikkudin, vechol zachvavn, vechol yerutat achasana, deinnun chulaka tava deyisrael.
Tana, behahi shaata dekudesha berich hu itgele betura desinay, havo chaman kol yisrael, keman dechame nehora baashishata, umehahu nehora hava chame kol chad vechad, ma dela chama yechezkel nevia.

May tama. mishshum deinnun kalin illain, itgeliu (nusach acher itgelifu) bechad, kema daamena, dichtiv, vechol haam roim et hakkolot. aval bichezkel, shechinta itgele birtichoy, vela yattir, vahava chame, keman dechame batar kotalin saggiin.
Amar rabbi yehuda, zakkaa chulaka demoshe, dichtiv beh, vayyered Adonai al har sinay vayyikra Adonai lemoshe, zakkaa dara, dichtiv beh, yered Adonai leene chol haam al har sinay.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo, deha mimina itgele ma deitgele. ma ben hay lehay. amar Rabbi yose, hacha besinay, resha vegufa demalka, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad, uvaatar deit resha, it gufa, aval bichezkel ketiv (Yechezkel 1:3) vattehi alav sham yad Adonai, deitgele yeda, vela gufa. vetanenan, afillu bida, yad Adonai illaa, yad Adonai tattaa.

Ta chaze, ketiv niftechu hashshamayim vaere marot elohim. marot ketiv chaser, leitchazaa divgin shechinta kaamar, deha vaere marot chaser, mare chad. amar Rabbi yesa, vechi shechinta lav kolla. amar rabbi yose, la dame resha demalka, leragloy demalka, af al gav decholla have begufa demalka.

Ta chaze, bishayahu ketiv, (yeshaya 6) vaere et Adonai, bichezkel ketiv, vaere marot elohim, hacha et, hatam marot. ma dechama da, chama da. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, dela hava nevia mehemana shelema kevavteh.
Vaere et Adonai, et dayyka. vaere marot elohim, marot dayyka. uvedarga chad havo. i
662: Hachi, amay la parish yeshaya kule hay. amar rabbi yose, da kalil, da parish. may taama parish kule hay yechezkel. ella, kolla itzterich beginehon deyisrael, deyindeun chavivuta dechaviv lehu kudesha berich hu, deshchinteh uretichoy atyayn ledayyayra benayyhu begaluta.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, beeretz kasdim, veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 23:13) hen eretz kasdim ze haam lo haya, amay itgele shechinta tamman. i tema beginehon deyisrael, hava tav detishre shechinta begavvavyyhu, vela yitgalyay. ella, hachi tana, i lav deitgalyay la havo yadin.
