Veha deitgalyay, ma ketiv, al nehar kevar, al mayya, beatar dela yisteav, vela (vaychi 222 amud bet) sharya mesoovuta. vehahu nahara, hava chad mearba naharin, denafkin migginta deeden, dichtiv al nehar kevar. may kevar. dichvar hava. meatar dishchinta sharya aloy. uchetiv vattehi alav sham yad Adonai, sham, vela beatar achara.

Amar rabbi chiyyay, ketiv umittochah demut arba chayyot veze marehen demut adam lahenna. tana beraza illaa, arba chivavn it, deinhu lego bego hechala kaddisha, veinnun kadmae, attikin deattika kaddisha, kelala dishma illaa. vichezkel chama, demut dirtichin illain, deha hu chama, meatar dela hava nahir kol kach. tana, kegavvna dilella, it letatta minayyhu, vechen bechullehu almin, kullehu achidan da beda, veda beda.

Vei tema leella yattir dechama. taninan, moshe chama beaspakalarya denahara, vechullehu nevie la chamu ella miggo aspakalarya dela nahara, dichtiv vaere marot elohim. uchetiv (Bamidbar 12:6) im yihye neviachem Adonai bammara elav etvadda vegomer lo chen avdi moshe vegomer, uchetiv pe el pe adabber bo.

Amar ribbi yose, ta chaze, dinviin kullehu legabbeh, kenukeva legabbe dechura, dichtiv pe el pe adabber bo umare. velishar neviim (ketiv, bemarot ulemoshe Adonai) bammara elav etvadda. bammara vela marot. kol shekken yechezkel, deafillu mare la ketiv beh, ella marot chaser, vekol shekken dichtiv bemoshe, velo vechidot, ella kol milla al bureyeh. zakkaa ihu dara, dinvia da share begavvavyyhu.

Amar ribbi yose berabbi yehuda, appin beappin chamu yisrael ziv yekara demalkehon, (nusach acher demarehon) vela hava behon sumin, vechiggerin, uketiin, vechershin. sumin, mashma dichtiv vechol haam roim. chigrin, dichtiv vayityatztzevu betachtit hahar. ketiin vechershin, naase venishma. ulezimna deate ketiv (Yeshayahu 35:6) az yedalleg keayyal pisseach vetaron leshon illem.

(Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle lemor. rabbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. bechamma archin, orayyta ashidat bevar nash, dela yechuv kame mareh. bechamma archin, yahiv leh eta, dela yiste mearchoy limina velismala. bechamma archin yahiv leh eta, hech yetuv kame mareh, veyimchol leh.

Ditnan, shit mea utelat asar zine eta, yahiv orayyta levar nash, lemehve shelim bemareh, begin demareh baa leotava leh bealma den uvealma deate. veyattir bealma deate, deha tanenan, kol ma dekudesha berich hu ashlim leh levar nash, meinnun tavan dezache behu lealma deate ishtelim behu. may taama. mishshum dealma deate dekudesha berich hu havi. (vei tema dehay alma lav dideh hu ella)

Vehachi tanenan, hay alma lokovleh dealma deate, la have ella kifrozdor legabbe teraklin. (begin kach alma deate dekudesha berich hu have) vechad zache hahu zakkaa, bedideh zache. detanya, ketiv (Devarim 18:2) venachala lo yihye lo bekerev echav. may tama. mishshum daAdonai hu nachalato. zakkaa chulakeh, man dezache leachasana achasanta illaa da. zache bah bealma da, uveveta dehay alma. kach bealma deate, uveveta illaa kaddisha, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem,
663: Zakkaa chulakeh dehahu zakkaa, demadoreh im malka beveteh.

Rabbi shimon amar, zakkaa chulakeh dehahu zakkaa, dezache lehay dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, im Adonai la ketiv, ella al Adonai. may al Adonai. atar deillain vetattain itmashshechan minneh, vetaavin lehahu atar, dichtiv, (Tehillim 121:1) meayin yavo ezri. uchetiv, (Daniel 7:13) vead attik yomayya meta ukedamohi hakervuhi. vetiuveta veinnuga detzaddikayya, leistakkela lehahu ziva, dechol ziva minneh nafka, veitmashshechan mineh kol innun kitrin.

Tu amar rabbi shimon, tanenan behay kera az titannag al Adonai, sofye dikra ma ketiv, vehirkavticha al bamote aretz, al hahu atar deikre bamote aretz, ihu leella mehay eretz, vehahu atar deikre bomote aretz, hayeynu shamayim. vehayeynu dichtiv al bomote aretz.

Al Adonai amar Rabbi abba, az teshev la ketiv, ella az titannag al Adonai, hayeynu shamayim. dichtiv, (Tehillim 57:6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, hayeynu eretz hachayyim, mimmashma dichtiv al bamote, leachlela tziyyon virushelem, deikrun bomote aretz, vehayeynu shamayim dilella, veeretz dilella. umilla deamar Rabbi shimon, hachi hu, vecholla chad, dichtiv vead attik yomaya meta vegomer, vechol hane mile laatar chad sallekin.

Amar Rabbi abba lerabbi shimon, lema li mor, hay kera kuleh, bemay okimna leh, dichtiv az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. amar leh, ha kolla ittemar, detafnuka veidduna al Adonai ketiv, atar deihu leella. uchetiv vead attik yomayya meta vegomer. al bomote aretz kema deittemar.

Vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim vegomer, vehayeynu nachalat yaakov. uvirkata devarich yitzchak leyaakov, al hay shamayim kaamar. uvarcheh bevirkata, dizminin benoy deyaakov, leachaya behahu talla lezimna deate, dichtiv veyitten lecha haelohim. lecha velo leachara. mittal hashshamayim, deveh zeminin metayya leachaya lezimna deate, denafik meattika lezera deappin, vesharya behay shamayim. istakkal Rabbi abba veamar, hasheta ishtema kolla veishtechach devirkata deyitzchak, illaa mimmay dachashivna.

Tana (tehillim 26) mi yemallel (64 amud alef) gevurot Adonai. mi yemallel, mi yedabber mibbae leh. amar Rabbi chiyyay, kema deat amer, (Devarim 23:26) vekatafta melilot beyadecha. gevurot Adonai, desaggiin innun, venafkin miggevura chad. vetana, chad gevura illaa, itra deitterin, mitattera, venafkin minneh chamshin tarin. minnehon yemina, uminhon semala. vechol chad vechad gevura itkere, vechol chad vechad mitattera, bekarditi gelifin nehorin, vechullehu ikrun gevurot Adonai.
Amar rabbi chiyyay, gevurot Adonai chaser ketiv, deha kullehu kelilan beda. yashmia kol tehillato: da hu shechinat ziv yekareh dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv utehillato mala haaretz.

Amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan vegomer, shem haechad pishon vegomer. ha illen bishmahan ikrun. vahani arba mehahu nahar denafik itmashshechan. ma shemeh dehahu nahara denafik. amar Rabbi shimon, (Vayikra 55 amud alef) yuval shemeh. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav, uchetiv velo yamish measot peri. may taama lo yamish, mishshum deal yuval yeshallach sharashav. veal da ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:11) uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav. uvegin kach ketiv yotze, (Vayikra 65 amud bet) yotze veeno posek.

Tana amar ribbi shimon ketiv (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim vegomer, vaydabber, begin leachreza milin. detana, beshaata dekudesha berich hu itgele, veshaari lemallela, illain vetattain itchalchalu, venafku nishmathon deyisrael.
Vetana hahu milla, hava tas milleella letatta, umitgallefa bearba ruche alma, vesalleka venachta. kad salleka, ishtaava miture deafarsemona
664: Dachya, veishtaava behahu talla dilella, veaschar besacharanehon deyisrael, vetavat behon nishmathon veaschar vimitgallefa beatreh, beluche avna. vechen kol milla umilla.
Amar rabbi shimon, kol milla umilla hava malya bechol innun taamin, bechol innun millin gezirin, agrin, veonashin, razin vesitrin keaskuppa (nusach acher kaasapevakea) da, deihi malya mikkolla.

Uveshaata dehava nafik hahu milla, itchaze chad. vechad hava mitgallefa beatroy itchazun behahu milla, shivin anpin, desallekin begavva, vechamshin kitrin (nusach acher retichin) chaser chad mehay gisa, vechamshin chaser chad miggisa achara kefattisha da, bezimna deihu batash betinara. kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 23:29) uchefattish yefotzetz sala. vahavu chaman kol yisrael ena beena, vahavu chaddan.

Vechullehu darin batrain kullehu izdemanu letamman, vechullehu kabbilu orayyta betura desinay, dichtiv, (Devarim 29:14) ki et asher yeshno po vegomer, veet asher enennu po immanu hayyom. vechullehu kol chad vechad kadka chaze leh. vechullehu chaman umekabbelin millin.

Elohim: da gevura. et: deitkelil bimina, kema detanenan (Bereshit 1) et hashshamayim, deihu yemina. veet haaretz, deihu semala. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 48:13) af yadi yasda eretz vimini tippecha shamayim. vimina da hu et. kol: leachlela kol shear kitrin. haddevarim: mitkashsheran da beda haelle: kol innun taamin, kol innun razin, kol innun sitrin, gizrin veonashin.

Lemor: lemeheve yaruta lecholla. dichtiv, (Devarim 33:4) tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha vegomer. dei tema legallaa ma dela itzterich legallaa lechol bar nash, ketiv anochi Adonai elohecha. kema daana temira vesatim, kach yihyu millin illen temirin usetimin belibbach.

Davar acher vaydabber elohim, chad. et kol haddevarim haelle lemor ha chamesh dargin acharanin. Rabbi yehuda amar, vaydabber elohim: gevura. et: yemina. kol: da veda (haelle, inun deitgalleyayn dichtiv vechol haam roim et hakkolot davar achar kol) amar Rabbi yitzchak, leachlela avraham dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol.

Haddevarim: leachlela shear kitrin deitkasyayn. haelle: innun deitgalleyayn. uchetiv vechol haam roim et hakkolot. lemor: da hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 12:4) eshet chayil ateret balah. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 3:1) lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto.

Amar Rabbi yitzchak, amay ityehivat orayyta beeshsha vachashocha, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:11) vehahar boer baesh ad lev hashshamayim choshech anan vaarafel. dechol man deyishtaddal beorayyta, ishteziv meeshsha achara degehinnam, umechashocha dimchashchin kol shear ammin leyisrael, devizchuteh deavraham ishtezivu yisrael meeshsha degehinnam.

Detanya amar leh kudesha berich hu leavraham, kol zimna devanecha yishtaddelun beorayyta, yishtezvun meillen. vei la, ha nura degihinnam deshalta behu, veyishtabedun beni amamya. amar leh, bitre keture la mizdakkefan millin, ella i nicha kammach, yishtezvun minnura degehinnam, veyishtabedun beni amamya, ad dituvun gabbach. amar leh yeot hu vadday, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:30) im lo ki tzuram mecharam. man hu tzuram. da hu avraham. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzur chutztzavtem. vaAdonai hisgiram, da kudesha berich hu, deistakkam al yedoy.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, miyyoma denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim ad yoma deityehivat orayyta, chamshin yomin havo. may tama amar Rabbi yehuda, mishshum innun shane deyovla, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:10) vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana.

Tana, amar rabbi shimon, hahu yovla appik lon leyisrael mimmitzrayim. vei tema deyovla mammash. ella (46 amud bet, 85 amud bet) missitra deyovla hava, umissitra deyovla ittear dina al mitzrae, uvegine kach chamshin illen deyovla havo.
Tana, lokovel da, chamshin zimnin ittemar veadkar beorayyta, nimmusin demitzrayim, veshvache innun kullehu, asher
665: Hotzeticha. (Devarim 4:34) vayyotziacha. (Shemot 13:9) ki beyad chazaka hotziacha. vechullehu zimne, chamshin innun, vela yattir, mishshum decholla beyovla itattar, umissitra deyovla ata kolla. uvegine kach, orayyta deate miggevura, itatterat bimina. dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. vetanya chamishsha kalin havo. vechullehu itchaziu behu, veitkelilu behu, veitatteru beda.

Amar Rabbi shimon, behahu zimna dekabbilu yisrael orayyta, yovla da attar beitteroy lekudesha berich hu, kemalka deitattar bego cheleh. dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo. man immo. da yovla. veyovla itattar, bechedva birchimu bishlimu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha. man em habbanim. amar rabbi shimon da yovla.

Amar ribbi yehuda, al da ketiv, (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha. man avicha veimmecha. amar ribbi yehuda, kema deukemuha besifra ditzniuta, dichtiv, (Vayikra 18:7) ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle vavy leman degalle arayaython.

Tana, amar ribbi yitzchak, beshaata dekudesha berich hu itgele betura desinay, izdaza tura. uveshaata desinay izdaza, kol shear ture alma izdazeu, vahavu sallekin venachtin, ad deoshit kudesha berich hu yedoy alayyhu, veityashshevu. vekala nafka umachreza, (Tehillim 114:5-6) ma lecha hayyam ki tanus hayyarden tisov leachor heharim tirkedu cheelim vegomer.

Veinnun tavan veamrin, millefanay adon chuli aretz. amar Rabbi yitzchak, millefanay adon, da ima, dichtiv im habbanim semecha. chuli aretz, da ima tattaa. millefanay eloah yaakov, da hu abba, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. veal hay ketiv baatara sheittera lo immo.

Mahu baatara. amar ribbi yitzchak, kema dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 23:26) veshaul vaanashav otrim et david. mishshum demitattar, bechivavra besumaka uviroka, bechol gavvnin dechullehu kelilan beh, veistacharan beh. amar Rabbi yehuda, baatara sheittera lo immo. man attara. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 60:7) uvet tifarti afaer.
Amar Rabbi yitzchak, orayyta ityehivat beeshsha ukkama, al gabbe essa chivvavra, leachlela yemina bismala, usemala deitchazzar yemina, dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo.

Amar ribbi abba, beshaata ditnana desinay hava nafik, salik eshsha, umitattar behahu tenana beitgalleyay, keatkela da, vesalik venachit, vechol rechin uvusemin divginta deeden, hava salik hahu tenana, bechezu dechivvavr vesumak veucham, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mekutteret mor ulevona mikkol avkat rochel.

Hahu tenana man hava. amar Rabbi yitzchak, (58 amud bet) shechinta deitgele letamman, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar ketimrot ashan. amar Rabbi yehuda, lamma lach kule hay ha kera shelim hu, dichtiv vehar sinay ashan kullo mippeni asher yarad alav Adonai baesh vayyaal ashano keeshen hakkivshan. zakkaa amma dechaman da, veyadin da.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, kad itgelifu atvavn beluche avana, havo mitchazyayn bitren sitrin, missitra da, umissitra da, veluchin meeven sanpirinon havo, veitgelifu veitchafyayn beeshsha chivvavra, veatvavn havo meeshsha uchama, umitgallefan bitren sitrin, missitra da umissitra da.

Amar Rabbi abba, luchin havo beenayyhu, veatvavn havo tasin, umitchazyayn bitren eshin, essa chivvavra, veeshsha uchama, leitchazaa kachada, yemina usemala, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah vegomer. veha ketiv mimino esh dat lamo. ella missitra digvura hava, veitkelilat bimina. uvegin kach essa chivvavra veeshsha uchama.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 32:16) vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vegomer, (maase elohim vadday) amar ribbi yehuda, vehalluchot ketiv, chad. tere havo umitchazyayn chad. vaesher amiran mitgallefe behu. chamesh kelilan bechamesh, lemeheve kolla yemina. maase elohim hemma vadday.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, shel sanpirinon havo,
666: Uteren avnin havo. veavnin havo setiman. nashiv kudesha berich hu berucha, veitpashatu veitgelifu teren luchin. Rabbi yehuda amar, keen sanpirinon havo. (dehava even tava) mashma dichtiv maase elohim hemma.

Amar leh, i hachi, sanpirinon da dehu avna tava yakkira mishshear avnin, lav ovada dekudesha berich hu innun. amar leh, bemay okimna maase elohim hemma. hemma dayyka. ella ta chaze, ketiv vehalluchot maase elohim. halluchot ketiv, vela ketiv vehaavanim maase elohim hemma.
Amar Rabbi shimon, kolla chad hu, aval illen teren luchin ad la itbere alma havo, veistallaku meerev shabbat, veavad lon kudesha berich hu, veovadoy havo.

Mimma itavidu. tana, mehahu talla illaa, denagid meattika kaddisha. vechad nagid veitmeshach lachakal detappuchin kaddishin, natal kudesha berich hu teren kippore minnayyhu, veitgelidu, veitavidu teren avnin yakkirin. nashav behu, veitpashatu litren luchin, hada hu dichtiv maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu. kema dichtiv, (Devarim 9:10) ketuvim beetzba elohim.

Tana, etzba elohim. hahu etzba salik laasara. kema deittemar, etzba elohim hi. vechol etzba veetzba salik laasara, ad deitavid yeda shelemata, dichtiv, (Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, charut al halluchot, nekivan havo avnin, veitchaziu litren sitrin, charut gillufa diglifin. amar Rabbi abba, mehay sitra itchaze sitra achara, veitkere mehacha, ma dichtiv besitra achara.
Rabbi elazar amar, benis havo ketivin, dechol beni nasha, havo amrin vesahadin, deha michtav elohim hu vadday, deha kol bene alma la yachlin leminda lon kema dahavo.

Ledatayyhu deinnun deamrin, nekivin havo, mi ketiv charut balluchot, al halluchot ketiv. ella hachi tana, chamishsha kalin innun limina, vechamsha lismala. veinnun dismala kelilan bimina. umin yemina, itchazun innun dismala, vehacha kolla ihu yemina, veitkelilan illen beillen, man dehava besitra da, chame lesitra achara, vekare lon leinun atvavn. deha tanenan, semala itchazar yemina, dichtiv mimino esh dat lamo, uvegin kach michtav elohim hu vadday.

Ha ketzad, man dehava missitra da, hava kare beda, anochi Adonai elohecha. umeillen atvavn hava chame, vekare lo tirtzach. hava kare lo yihye lecha. vahava chame vekare, lo tinaf. vahava kare lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav. vahava chame vekare lo tignov. vecholla missitra da, vechach lechullehu, ucheden missitra achara, vechullehu kelilan da beda kehay gavvna. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 32:16) michtav elohim hu. michtav elohim hu vadday.

Vayyered moshe el haam vayyomer alehem. rabbi yose amar, may amira da dichtiv vayyomer alehem, vela ketiv may kaamar. amar ribbi yitzchak, ta chaze, archa dealma hu, kad ate chedvavta levar nash, o kad ate tzaara, ad la yada minneh la yachil lemisbal, deha libba itperach leshaata. vechad yada minneh, kaim bekiumeh, veyachil lemisbal. kol shekken hacha, (nusach acher vehacha lav hachi) deha moshe amar lon kol ma dehava levatar, veatkif libbayyhu bemillin, vela yachilu lemisbal. kol shekken i la amar lon midi. ubbegin kach vayyomer alehem bekadmita, veittakkaf libbayyhu. ulevatar vaydabber elohim.

Veim kol da, la yachilu lemisbal, deha tanenan, amar Rabbi yehuda amar Rabbi chiyyay amar Rabbi yose, kad shamu milla dekudesha berich hu, parchat nishmatayyhu, vesalleka nishmatayyhu deyisrael, ad kurese yekara dileh, leitdabbeka tamman.
Amra orayyta kameh dekudesha berich hu, vechi lemaggana havena mittere alfe shenin, ad la itbere alma, lemaggana ketiv bah, (Vayikra 17:13) veish
667: Ish mibbene yisrael umin hager hagar betocham (Vayikra 24:15) veel bene yisrael tedabber lemor. (Vayikra 25) ki li vene yisrael avadim. an innun beni yisrael. bah shaata, ahadrat orayyta nishmatayyhu deyisrael, kol chad vechad leatreh. orayyta atkifat, vaachidat behu benishmatayyhu, leahaddera lehu leyisrael hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:8) torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh. meshivat nefesh mammash.

Tana, ketiv (divrei hayamim 1 29:23) vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech, kema dichtiv, (Melachim 1 10:19) shesh maalot lakkisse. Rabbi abba amar, dekayyeyma sihara beashlamuta. detanenan, beyomoy deshlomo, kayyeyma sihara beashlamuta.

Ematay beashlamuta. (nusach acher tana ketiv uterav chachmat shelomo vegomer may uterav, amar Rabbi abba dekayyeyma sihara beashlamuta may beashlamuta) dekayyeyma bachamishsha asar, kema detanenan, avraham. yitzchak. yaakov. yehuda. peretz. chetzron. ram. amminadav. nachshon. salmon. boaz. oved. yishay. david. shelomo. kad ata shelomo, kayyeyma sihara beashlamuta. hada hu dichtiv, vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech. uchetiv shesh maalot lakkisse. kolla kegavvna dilella.

Beyomoy detzidkiyya, kayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, veitpegim. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 13:10) vayareach lo yaggiah oro. detanenan, (Vayikra 40 amud bet) beyomoy detzidkiyya, itpegim sihara, veitchashshochu anpayyhu deyisrael.

Puk vechashiv, rechavam. aviha. asa. yehoshafat. yehoram. achazyahu. yoash. amatzyahu. uziyyahu. yotam. achaz. yechizkiyyahu. menashshe. amon. yoshiyyahu. tzidkiyyahu. vechad ata tzidkiyyahu itpegim sihara vekayyeyma al pegimuta. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 52:11) veet ene tzidkiyya ivver. beh zimna (Eicha 2:1) hishlich (Vayikra 114 amud alef) mishshamayim eretz. hay eretz itabbera mikkame shamayim, veitrachakat minneh, veitchashshecha hay eretz. (kelomar dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta).

Tana, beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay share sihara leanhara, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 22:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad. mahu vayyerad. dekariv shimsha legabbe sihara, veshare leanhara sihara. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 2:3) degel machane yehuda mizracha.

Betura desinay, itmana yehuda, rofinus bemalchuta, dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:1) vihuda od red im el veim kedoshim neeman. (nusach acher rabbi yitzchak amar mehacha vihuda od red im el have shuletana beshaata dehay el shallit malchuteh al tura desinay behay shaata shallit malchuta dihuda) mahu veim kedoshim neeman. kad amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh, neeman hava yehuda lekabbela malchuta, veshaari sihara leanhara.

(Shemot 20:2) anochi Adonai elohecha asher hotzeticha vegomer Rabbi elazar patach, (Mishlei 1:8) shema beni moser avicha veal tittosh torat immecha. shema beni musar avicha: da kudesha berich hu veal tittosh torat immecha: da keneset yisrael. man keneset yisrael. da bina. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 1:2) lehavin imre vina

Rabbi yehuda amar, musar avicha: da hi chachma. veal tittosh torat immecha: da hi bina. Rabbi yitzchak amar, ha veha, chad milla itperashu. detanenan, (Bereshit 47 amud bet) orayyta mechachma dilella nafkat. Rabbi yose amar, mibbina nafkat, dichtiv lehavin imre vina, uchetiv veal tittosh torat immecha.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, orayyta mechachma uvina itkelilat, dichtiv, shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha. Rabbi abba amar, becholla itkelilat, dechevan divillen teren itkelilat, itkelilat becholla. bechesed, bedina berachame. bechullehu shelemuta deitzterich milla. i malka umatronita mistakkemin, kolla mistakkemin. baatar deillen mishtakkechin, kolla mishtakkechin.

Rabbi yose amar, anochi: da shechinta. kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 46:4) anochi ered immecha mitzrayma. Adonai elohecha: (nusach acher kolla salik leella, lemaher kolla chad) (da keneset yisrael dichtiv veel tittosh torat immecha) Rabbi yitzchak amar, anochi: da shechinta. ufaska taama. kema deat amer (Bereshit 27:19) anochi esav bechorecha. Adonai elohecha: da kudesha berich hu. kema dichtiv, (dabeham 4) min hashshamayim hishmiacha et kolo. uchetiv attem reitem ki min hashshamayim dibbarti immachem. min hashshamayim (min hashshamayim mammash da kudesha berich hu.)
Asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim. asher: atar decholla meashsherin leh.
668: Hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim: da yovla. kema detanenan, missitra deyovla nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. uvegin kach, chamshin zimnin idkar yetziat mitzrayim beorayyta. chamshin yomin lekabbela orayyta. chamshin shenin lecheru deavdin.

Mibbet avadim: kema dichtiv, (Shemot 12:29) hikka chol bechor beeretz mitzrayim. vetanenan illen kitrin tattain, deitrechitzu behu mitzrae. kema deit beta leella, it beta letatta. beta kaddisha leella, dichtiv, (Mishlei 24:3) bechachma yibbane bayit. beta tattaa letatta, dela kaddisha, kema dichtiv mibbet avadim.
Tana, beshaata deittemar anochi, kol innun pikkude orayyta, demitachadan bemalka kaddisha illaa, besitra (sefer acher 5) kullehu hava kelilan behay milla.

Kema detanenan, kol pikkude orayyta, mitachadan begufa demalka. (davar achar bemalka kaddisha illaa) minnehon beresha demalka, uminhon begufa, uminhon bide malka, uminhon beragloy, velet man denafik min gufa demalka levar. uvegin kach, man defasha bechad pikkude orayyta, keman defasha begufa demalka, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi. bi mammash. vavy lechayyayvayya, deavrin al pitgame orayyta, vela yadin may ka avdin.

Deamar Rabbi shimon, hahu atar deihu chav legabbeh, hahu atar mammash galle choveh. (veamar Rabbi shimon kudesha berich hu mammash galle choveh) chav bekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu galle choveh, dichtiv, (Iyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. yegallu shamayim avono: da kudesha berich hu. veeretz mitkomama lo: da kudesha berich hu (nusach acher da keneset yisrael.)

Tanya, shamayim galleyayn choveh devar nash. uveshaata deihu galleya choveh, eretz avid dina devar nash, dichtiv veeretz mitkomama lo, lemebad dina beh. amar Rabbi yose, tanenan mishshemeh der shimon, beshaata deityehivat orayyta, ima uvenin bishlemuta ishtechachu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha.

Anochi Adonai elohecha. anochi, kema detanenan, bat hayta lo leavraham avinu, hi shechinta. veda bat. Adonai elohecha, dichtiv (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael. uchetiv (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah, ha ben.

Asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:12) yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem, uchetiv (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha. vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana ukeratem deror, ha ima uvenin. yatva ima yatvin benin. (vealmin) kullehu bechedva bishlimuta. veal da ketiv, em habbanim semecha. mitabbera ima, kullehu mitabberan beduchetayyhu. uchetiv, (Devarim 22:6) lo tikkach haem al habbanim. vetanenan, la yavid bar nash chove letatta, begin deitavar imma meal benin.
Amar Rabbi yitzchak, kolla kudesha berich hu. kolla hu. kolla chad. umillin illen, limchatztzede chakla itgalleyayn. zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate.

Tane amar Rabbi elazar, ketiv, bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz. uchetiv, (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. bemay okimna hani kerae, ha tanenan, detarvavyyhu kachada itberiu. melammed, shennata hakadosh baruch hu kav yemino uvara hashshamayim, unete kav semolo, uvara et haaretz. bekadmita et hashshamayim veet haaretz, ulevatar eretz veshamayim.

Tenan, ketiv, (Hoshea 2:23-24) bayyom hahu eene neum Adonai eene et hashshamayim vehem yaanu et haaretz. eene et hashshamayim, shamayim mammash. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:1) hashshamayim kisi. vehem yaanu et haaretz. haaretz mammash, dichtiv vehaaretz hadom raglay. shamayim, shamayim illain. veeretz, eretz illaa. detanya, kad ittakan shamayim da betikunoy, (itkkan) lokovleh dehay eretz, veteuveteh lekabbelah, bechad darga deikre tzaddik. kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam, veitdabbak behay eretz.
Umeresha demalka, ad hahu atar deshaari hay tzaddik, ate chad nahara
669: Kaddisha, mishcha dirvut, veattil bisgiut tiuveta, behay eretz kaddisha, venatal kolla hay eretz. ulevatar, mehay eretz ittezan kolla, illae vetattae. kidchura da, kad tiuveteh leitdabbeka benukeva, deappik zara dirvut, meresha democha, behahu ama, veattil benukeva, uminneh mitabbera nukeba, ishtechach, dechullehu shayyfin degufa, kullehu mitdabbekan benukeva, venukeba achida kolla. kedugema da taninan, kol deashlim laasara kadmae deve kenishta, notel agar kullehu. Rabbi yose omer, lokovle dechullehu.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Shmuel 2 22:10) vayyet shamayim vayyerad, uchetiv vayyerad Adonai leene chol haam al har sinay, (davar acher lo garsinan tanna) vayyet shamayim vayyerad, lean nachat. i tema denachat lesinay, al har sinay ketiv vela ketiv behar sinay.

Ella, vayyet shamayim vayyerad, lean nachat. amar Rabbi yose, (amar rabbi yehuda amar rabbi chiyyay) nachit bedargoy, middarga ledarga, umikkitra lechitra, ad deitdabbak behay eretz, ucheden itnehar sihara, vekayyeyma beashlamuta. hada hu dichtiv vayyet shamayim vayyerad, lehay eretz. ucheden ketiv, al har sinay. ma kayyma al har sinay, have ema da shechinta.

Rabbi abba amar mehacha, (Shemot 19:18) mippene asher yarad alav Adonai baesh. uchetiv (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu. uchetiv, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. vaAdonai himtir da hu eretz mean atar natil hay, sofye dikra mochach, dichtiv meet Adonai min hashshamayim, min hashshamayim mammash. rabbi chiyyay amar mehacha, vaydabber elohim et kol. kol, kelala decholla, deha behay talya kolla.

(Shemot 20:3) lo yihye lecha elohim acherim al panay. rabbi yitzchak amar, elohim acherim, leappaka shechinta. al panay, leappaka appe malka. divhu itchaze malka kaddisha, veinnun shemeh. vehu innun. hu shemeh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi. hu ushemeh chad hu berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya.

Tane rabbi shimon, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu kara lon adam, dichtiv, (Yechezkel la) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem, (Vayikra 1:2) adam ki yakriv mikkem. may taama kara lon adam. mishshum dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem. attem velo shear ammin. ubbegin kach adam attem, attem keruyin adam, veen ovde kochavim umazzalot keruyin adam.

Detanya, amar Rabbi shimon, kevan devar nash yisrael itgezar, al bivrit degazar kudesha berich hu beavraham, dichtiv (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. uchetiv (Micha 7:20) chesed leavraham. veshare lemeal behay atar. (nusach acher adam) kevan dezacha lekayyeyma pikkude orayyta, al beh behay adam, (nusach acher atar) veitdabbak (vaychi 216 amud alef) begufa demalka, ucheden ikre adam.

Vezara deyisrael ikrun adam. ta chaze, ketiv beh beyishmael, (Bereshit 16) vehu yihye pere adam. pere adam, velo adam. pere adam, mishshum deitgezar. vesheruta deadam hava beh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:25) veyishmael beno ben shelosh esre shana behimmolo et besar arlato, kevan deitgezar, al behay sheruta, deikre kol. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 16:12) vehu yihye pere adam, velo adam. yado vakkol, yado vakkol vadday, vela yattir, mishshum dela kabbil pikkude orayyta. sheruta hava beh, begin deitgezar, vela ishtelim befikkude orayyta. aval zara deyisrael, deishtelimu becholla, ikrun adam mammash, uchetiv (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

Amar ribbi yose, begin da, kol partzufin sharu, bar mippartzufa deadam. Rabbi yitzchak amar, kad itavad, itchaze diglifa go gelifin deashlamuta. amar ribbi yehuda, hayeynu deamre inshe kitroy bezika, betifsa shechiche.
Rabbi yehuda hava azil mikkapputekiyya lelud, lemecheme lerabbi shimon, dehava tamman, vahava rabbi chizkiyya azil immeh. amar rabbi yehuda lera chizkiyya, ha detanenan, kame Rabbi shimon, vehu yihye
670: Pere adam, vadday kach hu. veda hu berira demilla. sofye dikra dichtiv, veal pene chol echav yishkon. mahu veal pene chol echav yishkon.
Amar leh, la shemana, vela ema. deha olifna, ketiv (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe. asher sam moshe, atta yachol lomar. dela sam moshe, i atta yachol lomar.

Patach Rabbi yehuda veamar, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha. man dezache beorayyta, vela itperash minah, zache litren chayyin, chad bealma den, vechad bealma deate. dichtiv chayyecha, tere. vechol man deyitperash minah, keman demitperash min chayye, uman demitperash mer shimon, keillu mitperash mikkolla.

Uma behay kera deihu patach pitcha, la yachilna lemeal bah. pitgame orayyta distimin, al achat kamma vechamma. vavy ledara, der shimon ben yochay yistelik minneh. dechad anan kayymin kame der shimon, mabbuin delibba petichin lechol ivar, vecholla mitgalya. vechad itperashna minneh. la yedana midi, vechol mabbuin setimin.

Amar Rabbi chizkiyya, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:25) vayyatzel min haruach asher alav veyitten al shivim ish hazzekenim, kevutzina da, denaharin minne kamma butzinin, vehu bekiumeh shechiach. kach Rabbi shimon ben yochay, mare devutzinin, hu nahir lecholla, unehora la ade minneh, veishtechach bekiumeh. azlu ad dematu legabbeh.

Kad matu gabbeh, ashkechuhu, dehava yativ velae beorayyta, vahava amar, (Tehillim 102:1) tefilla leani ki yaatof velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho. kol tzelota deyisrael tzelota, utzelota deani illaa mikkullehu. may taama. mishshum dehay salleka ad kurese yekara demalka, veitattar beresheh. vekudesha berich hu mishtabbach (nusach acher mitattef) behahi tzelota vadday. tefilla deani, tefilla ikre.

Ki yaatof. ittufa da, lav ittufa dechasu hu, deha let leh. ella, ketiv hacha ki yaatof. uchetiv hatam, (Eicha 2:19) haatufim beraav. velifne Adonai yishpoch sicho, deyikbal kamme mareh, veda nicha leh kamme kudesha berich hu, mishshum dealma mitkayyeyma beh, kad la ishtechachu shear kayyme alma bealma. vavy leman dehahu miskena yekabbel alohi lemareh, mishshum demiskena kariv lemalka yattir mikkullehu, dichtiv, (Shemot 22:26) vehaya ki yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani.

Velishar bene alma, zimnin dishma, zimnin dela shama. may tama. mishshum dediureh demalka behane mani tevire, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach. uchetiv (tehillim la) karov Adonai lenishbere lev. (Tehillim 51:19) lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze.

Mikkan tanenan, man denazif bemiskena, nazif bishchinta, dichtiv veet dakka ushefal ruach. uchetiv (Mishlei 22:23) ki Adonai yariv rivam vegomer. begin deappotroppa dilhon takkifa, veshallita al kolla, dela itzterich sahade, vela itzterich ledayyayna achara, vela natil mashkona, kishar dayyayna. uma mashkona natil, nishmatin devar nash, dichtiv vekava et kovehem nafesh.
Tu amar tefilla leani, kol atar deikre tefilla, milla illaa hi, dehi salleka laatar (dekudesha berich hu echad) illaa. tefilla deresha, innun tefile demalka, deanach lehu.

Rabbi shimon aschar resheh, vechama lera yehuda uler chizkiyya, dematu gabbeh. batar desiyyem istakkal behu. amar lehu, sima hava lechu veitavid minnayychu. amru leh, vadday defitcha illaa patach mor, vela yachilna lemeal bah.

Amar, may hi. amru leh, (Bereshit 16:12) vehu yihye pere adam, vesofye dikra baena leminda, dichtiv veal pene chol echav yishkon, mahu al pene chol echav. deha berira dechuleh kera yedana, vehay la yedana, desefeh dikra, la itchaze kerisheh.
Amar lon, chayyechon, kolla chad milla hi, uvechad darga salleka. tana, kamma panim lappanim, it leh lekudesha berich hu. panim denaharin. panim dela naharin. panim tattain. panim
671: Rechikin. panim kerivin. panim dilgo. panim dilvar. panim dimina. panim dismala.

Ta chazi, zakkain innun yisrael kameh dekudesha berich hu, daachidan beanpin illain demalka. beinnun panim dehu ushemeh achidan behu, veinnun ushemeh chad hu. ushear ammin achidan beinnun panim rechikin, beinnun panim tattain. uvegini kach innun rechikin miggufa demalka, deha chamena kol innun demitzrayim, kerivoy deyishmael, kema achin ukerivin havo leh, vechullehu havo beanpin tattain, beinnun panim rechikin.

Uvegineh deavraham, kad itgezar yishmael, zacha, deshavve madoreh vechulakeh baatar deshalita al kol innun panim rechikin vetattain, al kol innun panim dishar ammin. hada hu dichtiv yado vakkol, uvegine kach al peni chol echav yishkon, kelomar, yeshavve madoreh vechulakeh leella mikkullehu, dichtiv yado vakkol, deshalta al kol shear panim diltatta. ubbegin kach al pene chol echav vadday, dela zachu kevavteh.

Atu rabbi yehuda ver chizkiyya, venashku yedoy. amar ribbi yehuda, hayeynu deamri inshe, chamara bedurdeya, unevia devera, biktira dekizra itattar. vavy lealma, kad yistallak mor minneh. vavy ledara, deyitteara behahu zimna. zakkaa dara deishtemodun leh lemor. zakkaa dara deihu share begavveh.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya, ha tanenan, giyyora kad itgezar, ikre (Vayikra 168 amud alef) ger tzedek, vela yattir. vehacha amar mor yado vakkol. amar rabbi shimon, kolla itkeshar bechad. aval giyyora tanenan. shane yishmael, delav giyyora hu. bereh deavraham hava, bereh dekaddisha hava. uchetiv beh beyishmael, (Bereshit 17:20) hinni berachti oto. ketiv hacha, berachti oto. uchetiv hatam, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. veal kach ketiv, yado vakkol.

Uvegine kach ketiv, al pene chol echav yishkon. dei shear kerivoy itgezaru (sefer acher itgayyeyru) ikrun gere tzedek, vela yattir, vehu yattir veillaa mikkullehu. kol shekken innun dela itgezaru, dekayymin beinnun appin rechikin, beinnun appin tattain. veihu, madoreh leella mikkol panim didhu, umikkol panim deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, hada hu dichtiv, al pene chol echav yishkon. amar ribbi yehuda, kudesha berich hu begin kach achriz veamar, lo yihye lecha lohim acherim al panay, deda hu mehemanuta dileh.
(Shemot 20:4) lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna. ha ittemar. veamar rabbi yosi, kol partzufin share, bar mippartzufa deadam, deha hay partzufa shalit becholla.

Davar acher, lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna. rabbi yitzchak patach, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) al titten et picha lachati et besarecha. kamma it leh levar nash leizdahara al pitgame orayyta, kamma it leh leizdahara dela yite behu, vela yafik meorayyta ma dela yada, vela kabbil merabbeh. dechol man deamar bemille deorayyta ma dela yada, vela kabbil merabbeh, aleh ketiv lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna. vekudesha berich hu zammin leitpara minnih, bealma deate, bezimna denishmateh baya lemeal leducheta, dachyayn lah levar, vetishtetze mehahu atar ditzrira bitzrora dechayye dishar nishmatin.

(Rabbi yehuda omer mehacha) kema detanenan, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) lamma yiktzof haelohim al kolecha. kolecha: da hi nishmateh devar nash. amar rabbi chiyyay, al da ketiv, ki Adonai elohecha el kanna. may tama. mishshum dekanni lishmeh becholla. i begin partzufin mekanni lishmeh, mishshum dimshakker bishmeh. i mishshum orayyta.

Tanenan, orayyta kolla shema kaddisha hi, delet lach milla beorayyta dela kalil bishma kaddisha. uvegini kach, bae leizdahara, begin dela yite bishmeh kaddisha, vela yeshakker beh. uman dimshakker bemalka illaa, la alin leh lifalteroy demalka, veyishtetze mealma deate.
Amar rabbi abba, ketiv hacha lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna. uchetiv hatam,
672: (Shemot la) pesal lecha sheni luchot avanim. kelomar, lo taase lecha fesel, la tabed lecha orayyta achara dela yadat, vela amar lach rabbach. may taama. ki anochi Adonai elohecha el kanna, ana hu dezammin leitpara minach bealma deate, beshaata denishmeta baya lemeal kammay, kamma zeminin leshakra bah, uleayyeyla lah go gehinnam.

Tanya, amar Rabbi yitzchak, lo taase lecha vegomer, devae bar nash dela leshakra bishma dekudesha berich hu (sefer acher davar achar lo taase lecha pasal vegomer devae bar nash dela leshikra bishmeh dekudesha berich hu, umay ihu, da berit et kayyeyma kaddisha deman dimshakker behay berit meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu) dekishra kadmaa, deitkesharu yisrael bekudesha berich hu, kad itgezaru. veda hu kiyyuma kadmaa decholla, lemeal bivrit deavraham, dehu kishra dishchinta. uvae bar nash, dela leshakkera behay berit, deman dimshakker behay berit, meshakker bekudesha berich hu. may shikra. hu, dela yeul hay berit birshuta achara. kema deat amar (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar.

Rabbi yehuda amar mehacha, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki banim zarim yaladu. man dimshakker behay berit, meshakker bekudesha berich hu. mishshum dehay berit bekudesha berich hu achida, uchetiv lo taase lecha fesel vechol temuna asher bashshamayim mimmaal vegomer.

(Shemot 20:Adonai) lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem. Rabbi elazar hava azil bearcha, vahava Rabbi chiyyay immeh. amar Rabbi chiyyay, ketiv (Devarim 21:11) veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar vegomer, may taama. veha ketiv lo titchatten bam. amar leh, beod devirshutayyhu kayyme.

Veta chazi, let lach intu beammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot keshera kadka chazi. detanenan, amay asmich parsheta da, leven sorer umore. ella bevadday, man denasiv hay itteta, ben sorer umore yarit minah. may taama. mishshum dekashe lemebar zuhama minah, vechol shekken hahi deitnesivat bekadmita, dedina bedina itdevak, veisteavat bah, vekashya zuhama lemebar minah, vehayeynu deamar moshe binshe midyan, (Bamidbar 31:17) vechol ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu.

Zakkaa chulakeh, dehahu bar nash deyarit achasanta da, venatir lah. divhahu achasana kaddisha itdabbak bar nash bekudesha berich hu, kol shekken i zache befikkude orayyta, deha pashit malka yemineh lokovleh, veitdevak begufa kaddisha. veal da ketiv behu beyisrael, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem. uchetiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai. banim attem mammash. dichtiv, (shamevated) beni vechori yisrael. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

(Shemot 20) la tissa et shem vegomer. Rabbi shimon patach, (Melachim 2 4:2) vayyomer eleha elisha ma eese lach haggidi li ma yesh lach babbayit. amar lah elisha, kelum it lach al ma detishre birchata dekudesha berich hu, detanenan asur leh levar nash, levarcha al patora rekanayya. may tama. mishshum devirkata dilella, la sharya baatar rekanayya.
Uvegine kach, bae bar nash lesaddera al patoreh, chad nahama, o yattir, levarcha aloy. vei la yachil, bae leshayyeyra mehahu mezona deachal, al ma divarech. vela yishtekach divarech berekanyya.

Kevan deamra, en leshifchatcha chol babbayit ki im asuch shamen. amar vadday ha birchata shelemata behay, dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:1) tov shem mishshemen tov. dishma kaddisha mishshemen nafka, leitbarcha, leadleka butzinin kaddishin. may (9 amud alef) shemen da. (kema deat amar Bereshit 2:10 venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan) Rabbi yitzchak amar, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh vegomer. Rabbi elazar omer, illen ture deafarsemona dachya.

Amar Rabbi shimon, tov shem, kamma tava shema illaa, devutzinin illain kaddishin, kad kullehu naharin mishshemen tov, kema daamena. veasir leh levar nash, leadkera shemeh dekudesha berich hu berekanyya. dechol man deidkar shema dekudesha berich hu berekanyya, tav leh dela itbere.
Rabbi elazar amar, la itzterich lemidkar shema kaddisha ella batar milla.
673: (Kelomar alemaleh) deha shema kaddisha, la idkar beorayyta, ella batar teren millin, dichtiv bereshit bara elohim.

Rabbi shimon amar, la idkar shema kaddisha, ella al olam shalem. dichtiv, (bareasheyteb) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. mikkan, dela leadkera shemeh kaddisha berekanyya. uchetiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav. (sefer acher ketiv lo tissa et sham Adonai elohecha lashshav dela leadkera shemma kaddisha berekanayyay ella bevirchata o bitzlota uman deidkar shemma kaddisha berekanayyay dela bevirchata o bitzlota ko nishmateh nafka minneh zeminin leitpara minneh ulenakma minneh nukemin dichtiv ki lo yinnake Adonai et asher yissa et shemo lashshav)

Vetanenan, amar rabbi yosi, mahu beracha. shema kaddisha. begin demineh mishtechach bircheta, lechol alma. uvircheta la ishtechach al atar rekanayya, vela sharyay aloy, hada hu dichtiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav.

(Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava
674: Ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.
Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata
675: Beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.
Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol
676: Melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.
677: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha. rabbi chiyyay patach, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden vegomer. venahar, da neviu demabbua, denafik tadir vela pasak. uminnahara demabbua da, itshakya kol ginta deeden. vehahu nahara demabbua kaddisha, ikre av. may taama. mishshum deihu nevia leittezana leginta.

Rabbi abba amar, eden mammash ikre av. mishshum dehay eden, mishtechach mehahu atar, deikre ayin. uvegini kach, ikre av. veha ukimna, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, veikre av. kema (ayyen sof hassefer 13 mispar livnat hassappir) deat amar, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu.

Rabbi elazar amar, kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. et avicha, et dayyka, leachlela shechinta (davar achar ilaa). rabbi yehuda amar, kabbed et avicha, setam. veet immecha, setam. deha kolla hava beminyayna. et, lerabbot kol ma dilella vetatta.

Rabbi yosi amar, hay deamar rabbi abba, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, shappir. deha olifna, hahu detamir vela it beh sheruta, karenan hu. meatar (Vayikra 2, amud alef 78, 290 amud alef) desheruta ishtechach, karenan atta. veikre av. vecholla chad. berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya amen.

Rabbi chizkiyya amar, vadday kolla chad. kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. deha tenan, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, hahu atar deikre banim. uvegine kach setima demilla, kabbed et avicha veet immecha, leachlela kolla, dilella vetatta. Rabbi yitzchak amar, leachlela beh rabbeh, dehu ail leh lealma deate. amar rabbi yehuda, bichlala dekudesha berich hu have.

Tana, behane chamesh amiran, kalil kolla. behane chamesh amiran, itgelifu chamesh acharanin, vadday chamesh go chamesh. ha ketzad. anochi Adonai elohecha, (84 amud bet) lokovel lo tirtzach. detanenan, (amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yehuda) teren illen, bichlala chada itteklilan, deman dekatil, azir demuta vetzalma demareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam.

Amar Rabbi chiyyay, ketiv (bareasheytet) sofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech vegomer, (shofech dam haadam) man deshafich dama, keillu azir demuta vetzalma dilella, kelomar, la azar demuta da, ella demuta achara, mashma dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech. baadam illaa, mate hay pegimuta, mehahu dama deoshid. may taama. mishshum ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uvegin kach, ha beha talya.

Lo yihye lecha, lokovel lo tinaf da meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, deitreshim beh bevar nash. uveda, kamma vechamma chovin vegazrin veonashin, talyayn. uman dimshakker behay, meshakker beh bemalka, dichtiv, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu. uchetiv lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem, veha beha talya.
Lo tissa lokovel lo tignov. uchetiv (Mishlei 29:24) cholak im gannav sone nafsho alla yishma velo yaggid. vadday ha beha talya, deha gannava leda izdaman, leumaa beshikra. man deavid da, avid da.

Zachor et yom hashshabbat, lokovel lo taan vereacha ed shaker. deamar Rabbi yosi, shabbat sahaduta ikre. uvae bar nash lesahada al ha dichtiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer. veshabbat kelala (nusach acher sahaduta) decholla. veamar Rabbi yosi, may dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, kema deat amar (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, uman deashid shikra, meshakker beshabbat, dehi sahaduta dikshot, uman dimshakker beshabbat, meshakker beorayyta kulla. ubbegin kach, ha beha talya.
Kabbed et avicha, lokovel lo tachmod eshet reecha. veamar Rabbi yitzchak, kabbed et avicha, avicha mammash. deha man dechamid itteta, veolid bar, hahu bar okir leachara, dela
678: Avuy. uchetiv kabbed et avicha vegomer, lo tachmod bet reecha, sadehu. uchetiv hacha, al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. hahu deyahav lach, yehe dilach, velo tachmod achara. vadday ha beha talya.

Veillen chamesh kadmae, kelilan chamesh acharanin. uvegine kach, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo. decholla itavid yemina. veal da, bachamishsha kalin orayyta ityeyhivat. amar Rabbi yehuda, kullehu havo chamesh go chamesh. lokovlehon chamishsha chumeshe tora.

Tane Rabbi elazar, beillen eser amiran, itgelifu kol pikkude orayyta, gezirin veonashin. dachya umesaava. anfin vesharashin. ilanin unetiin. shemayya veara. yamma utehome. deha orayyta shema dekudesha berich hu havi, ma shema dekudesha berich hu itgelif beeser amiran, uf orayyta itgelifa beeser amiran. illen eser amiran innun shema dekudesha berich hu. veorayyta kolla shema chad have, shema kaddisha dekudesha berich hu mammash.

Zakkaa chulakeh, deman dezache bah. man dezache beorayyta, zache bishma kaddisha. (dekudesha berich hu mammash) Rabbi yosi amar, bekudesha berich hu mammash zache, (sefer acher ucheneset yisrael) deha hu ushemeh chad hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin amen.

(Shemot 20:20) lo taasun itti elohe kesef velohe zahav. amar Rabbi yosi, (davar achar lo garsinan may tama. mishshum 436) (Chagai 2:8) li hakkesef veli hazzahav, af al gav deli hakkesef veli hazzahav, lo taasun itti, itti: kelomar oti.

Amar Rabbi yitzchak, ketiv (Yirmeyahu 10:6) meen kamocha Adonai gadol atta vegadol shimcha bigvura vegomer, (gadol atta vegadol shimcha) gadol atta, hayeynu li hakkesef. vegadol shimcha bigvura, hayeynu veli hazzahav. illen teren gavvnin la mitchazyayn, vela mitpaaran, bar kad innun gelifin baatar chad, bean atar itgelifu. beyisrael. kan itchazun gavvnin leitpaara, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Rabbi yehuda patach, (Yeshayahu 61:10) sos asis baAdonai tagel nafshi belohay vegomer, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, meammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dechedvevta vetafnuka dilhon bekudesha berich hu, dichtiv sos asis baAdonai. kevan deamar baAdonai, amay ketiv belohay. ella hachi amru yisrael, i berachame ate alana, sos asis baAdonai. i bedina, tagel nafshi belohay.

May tama. mishshum deillen beh itgelifu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 61:10) ki hilbishani bigde yesha. mahu bigde yesha. gavvnin, deitgelifu leistakkela beh. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 2 22) yishu vegomer el Adonai. yesha istakkeluta hu. man devae leistakkela bi, bigvavnin dili yistakkal. may taama. mishshum dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 61:10) meil tzedaka yeatani, tzedaka mammash, digvavnin beh itgelifu. kechatan yechahen peer, ha gavvna chad. vechakkalla tade keleha, ha gavvna achara. vechad gavvnin mitchabberan, beh shaata itchazyayn, vechullehu teivin leachazaa, uleistakkela beh.

Rabbi yosi amar, sos asis baAdonai, teren chedvavn. baAdonai: berachame. tagel nafshi, ha (chad chedva) bedina. amar Rabbi yehuda, becholla chedva al chedva. vechedva detziyyon, zammin kudesha berich hu leachdaa leyisrael, bechedvavta yattir mikkolla, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 35:10) ufeduye Adonai yeshuvun uvau tziyyon berinna vegomer, ufeduye Adonai yeshuvun, ha chad. uvau tziyyon berinna, ha tere. vesimchat olam al rosham, ha telat. sason vesimcha yassigu, ha arba. lokovlehon dearba zimnin deitpezaru yisrael bene amamya. ucheden ketiv (Yeshayahu 12:4) vaamartem bayyom hahu hodu laAdonai kiru vishmo vegomer.
Vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle. kol haddevarim, kelala da, hu kelala decholla, kelala dilella vetatta.

Anochi, raza dealma illaa, beraza dishma kaddisha Yahu. anochi, itgalya veitgeniz. itgalya beraza kaddisha dechurseyay, desihara kayyeyma bishlimu kachada, kad shimsha shalta, vesihara itnehirat, velet lah shevacha, bar shevacha
679: Anochi, beashlemut razin dishlimu dechuresyyay letatta, veistallaku chevan kaddishin, veihi ittaknat betikkunaha. vechad ihi shappira bechezu, uvaalah ate legabbaha, keden ikre anochi.

Anochi, raza decholla kachada, bichlala dechol atvavn, bishvile orayyta, denafku miggo raza illaa, behay anochi, talyayn razin illain vetattain. anochi, raza lemehav agar tav letzaddikayya, deka mechakkan leh venatre pikkude orayyta, behay, it lon bitchona kadka chazi lealma deate, vesimanich (Bereshit 41:44) ani faro.

Anochi velo yihye lecha, ittemar beraza deorayyta, veda ihu zachor veshamor. anochi, raza setima veganiz, bechol innun dargin dealma illaa, bichlala chada. vechevan deittemar anochi, itchabbar kolla kachada, beraza chada.
Anochi, raza ditren kursevavn. ani Adonai dechuresya achara (nusach acher ani kuresyay chada. 20, kuresyay achara illaa.)

Anochi, deka itdache makdesha, venucheraa la itkerav bahadeh, umakdesha nahir bilchodoy, deka itbattal behahi shaata yetzer hara mealma, vekudesha berich hu istallak bikareh bilchodoy, ucheden ittemar anochi Adonai elohecha. raza shelim, bishma kaddisha. 1: leyachada raza dishma kaddisha bedargoy, lemeheve chad. begin deraza dileh ihu 6. 50: raza lemidchal mikudesha berich hu, uleminda deit din veit dayyayn, veit agar tav letzaddikayyay ufureanut lerashiayya, begin deraza dileh Adonai tattaa.

20: Lekaddesha shema kaddisha bechol yoma, leitkaddesha bedargin kaddishin, uletzallaa tzelota legabbeh bechol zimna, leistalleka kitra illaa, raza dechuresyyay illaa, al gabbe chivavn illain, kedka yeot, veraza dileh Adonai illaa.

10: Leishtaddela beorayyta yemama velele, ulemigzar geziru, beraza litmanya yomin, ulekaddesha buchra. uleannacha tefilin vetzitzit umezuza. ulemimsar nafsha legabbe kudesha berich hu, uleitdabbeka beh. illen innun teresar pikkudin illain, dichlilan 236 pikkudin acharanin deinnun beraza deanochi, kelala dezachor. veat da, la itchallaf beatar achara da, begin deihi 10, raza illaa, kelala deorayyta, uveillen teresar, it teresar mechilin derachame, detalyayn minnayyhu, vechad deshalta lemeheve telesar.

Lo yihye lecha, raza deshamor, bitlat mea veshittin vechamesh pikkude orayyta. 30: raza dela lemehav yekar urevu leelaha achara. 30: migaddela defarach vesalik baavira, dela yiste libba, lemivne lah leelaha achara, kema deit raza, devone migaddela. (lelaha achara) 30: dela lemifni bediyyukena deavoda zara, dela leharehara avatraha, dela lesaggeda, vela leachfeya garmeh leelaha achara.

1: Dela lechallefa yichuda demareh, begin taavavn acharanin. 1: dela leharehara deit elaha achara bar minneh. 1: dela lemiste batar bidin udechuro, beraza dediyyukena deadam, vela bediyyukena achara. 1: dela lemishal min metayyay, vela lemebad charshin. 1: dela yome befumoy, bishma deelaha achara. ad hacha, teresar acharanin, deinnun pikkude shamor. uveillen teresar, talyayn telat mea vechamshin utelat pikkude deshamor acharanin, dichlilan beillen teresar, veraza da anochi.

Amar rabbi shimon, tu tanenan, anochi kelala deella vetatta, kelala deillain vetattain, kelala dechevan kaddishin, dichlilan beh, kolla hu beraza deanochi. lo yihye lecha letatta, raza ditresar chevan tattain.

Lo taase lecha fesel. pislu mehahu atar illaa, mehahu atar kaddisha. fesel. pesolet dikdusha deihu raza detaava achara. veraza da, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:4) vaere vehinni ruach seara baa min hatztzafon vegomer. vechol temuna hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:4) veesh mitlakkachat. ki anochi Adonai elohecha, begin leatara libba legabbe ella, vela lenachta letatta vela lemikrav litra beta. el kanna, dekina ihu behahu atar.
Veraza da, (Mishlei 30:21) tachat shalosh ragza eretz. veihu lo taase lecha, chad. fesel, teren. vechol temuna, telat. veeretz da, al da
